description:
Welcome to my sailboat. Sit, relax and enjoy the incredible perspective of Barcelona from the sea. We will start our sail from the Port Olimpic and navigate until near the coastline in order to show you the beauty of the city. You will have a chance to see Sagrada Familia, Torre Agbar, Tibidabo, Montjuic from the water! I'll teach you some basics of sailing to make you feel comfortable on board. On a hot summer day there is nothing better than feeling the sea breeze on your skin and driving a boat by yourself while making new friends from all over the world.

When we will get to a special point with the best view possible, we’ll lower the sail and stop to swim in the crystal clear waters of the Mediterranean sea. Those of you who want to try the paddle board will do this and the others will just have a lot of fun with floating toys.

After swimming, we will have an aperitif and a glass of cava to make your day in Barcelona even more wonderful. On the way back to the Port Olimpic you will lie on the wide cover of our boat to take a sunbath.

The most important for me is to share good feelings with people: you are on vacation, and I want to convert this day into amazing memories that you will keep from Barcelona.

This activity is suitable for kids, but you must let me know in advance. We also offer private celebrations.

My friend Max helps me with the tours
Other things to note
Wear appropriate clothing for the season, as well as comfortable shoes and sun cream. This experience is subject to weather conditions. If these conditions are not optimal, you will be refunded.

This sailing trip was so much fun! We had John/Jean as our skipper and he was so thoughtful on the trip. The water was rough so we didn’t end up swimming, but he made sure to put the boat in some very aesthetic areas for us all to take some incredible photos. 10/10 would book again!

It was super nice experience! Unfortunately we didn’t get to swim because of the strong wind, but the host made sure our sailing experience was still nice! Snacks and drinks were nice touch! Thank you :)
This was an amazing experience and so much fun. You should definitely do this if you get a chance! Watch out for jellyfish…
We had such a great evening on the Maggie May! It was the perfect way to end our time in Barcelona with great personal touches and thoughtfulness for the whole group!
Great experience! Beautiful view of Barcelona, good atmosphere, very nice and attentive host!! We were able to swim, float and see dolphins!!!

We booked this experience on our last day of our trip. It was perfect! We got to swim in the ocean for a bit and just enjoyed watching the waves from the boat too. I would completely recommend booking 😊
Great host and boat! It was a very nice scenery and totally worth it. Great weather, we got to swim, drink and take a lot of nice photos.

Amazing view, I felt so relaxed looking over the Mediterranean sea and watching the sunset over Barcelona. I wish i would have stayed another night to experience it again.
The guide was very considerate and informed us before boarding that the waters were a bit wavy and that it would be difficult to go for a swim and if we wanted to we could reschedule for another day or get a refund.
This was the perfect boat trip to experience Barcelona by water. We met great people and had a lovely day swimming and sunning on the boat.
We had a great experience, free drinks, snacks. When we stopped for swimming Jean was very careful, he provided life jackets, safety rings and paddlesurf. Definitely going back next time.
It was really great to see Barcelona from the sea and swimming was super amazing. We just loved it, thank you :) I highly recommend this experience.

Although we didn’t do much sailing, the Mediterranean Sea was so refreshing to swim and relax in for an hour or so. Wish the guide had provided a little more information regarding sailing/Barcelona, but overall a pleasant boat trip with fun fellow travellers.
This sailing excursion was a blast! Jumping into the open water, sailing along the sea, and a glass of cava to end the afternoon was wonderful.

It was amazing!! The boat ride was wonderful and we were explained the entire skyline as well as given recommendations on places to visit and eat. Swimming was so much fun, the water was so warm. Couldn’t have asked for a better experience
I had such a good time on this trip as a solo traveler. The boat was beautiful, the hosts were amazing, and the scenery was great. Can’t recommend enough!
Marc & Sergio were awesome captains! Everything was such a vibe and it was the perfect way to end our Barcelona trip! Thank you for the memories. 😍👌🏼

Nothing but absolutely amazing things to say about this experience! Met so many new, fun people and our captains were AMAZING with accommodating us. We did this on our last day in Barcelona around 6-8pm and the sun was perfect and the water was amazing. 100% must do to escape the heat of Spain in July. You won’t regret it!

Great experience! Best way to see the entire city and get a feel for its beauty. Our captain was very knowledgeable and a lot of fun to talk with. We had a great time meeting the other people in the boat and overall had a phenomenal time.
The experience is very good, you can swim and play in the sea, it would be more perfect if I didn't get seasick lol
Spectacular everything. Carlos is a great host and very fun. Don't miss out! Especially watching the sunset from the sea. Wonderful!!!!

What better way to take in the skyline of Barcelona than from the clear waters of the Mediterranean on a sail boat? We had an amazing time and the amount of time was perfect. Would recommend this trip to families for sure (we had 13 and 15 year old girls with us).
We had a great time sailing with Carlos! It was a great experience and a cool way to see the city. Would recommend and would do it again!

It was a stunning experience to see the sun set behind the mountains of Barcelona, get in the water to swim in the Mediterranean and watch the red moon rise behind us as we sailed back to pier.

I made some great friends and really enjoyed engaging with our Captain Marc. He was super hard-working and industrious. He piloted the ship, ran drinks and food to everyone, explained the coastline and ensured everyone was safe and sound (not to mention a masterful docking back to port!). He even was even able to able to help some seasick passengers recover on the ride back!

Additionally he answered many questions from this curious tourist and was patient as I practiced my Spanish!

I would highly recommend this for anyone.
great trip, perfect boat ride with swimming. Marc was the perfect host, and a must to do in Barcelona. sunset and moon rise was unbelievable. would do again in a heartbeat.

Amazing experience and a great host.
I just wish I would have taken a dramamine tablet before to really enjoy.
The motion sickness got the best of me.
The sunset boat ride was a great way to see Barcelona. The captain was very friendly and relaxed. Loved that we had a tube and paddleboard as options for additional fun.
We had a great time on the boat and the host couldn’t have been nicer! It was a beautiful sunset sail complete with swimming, tubing, and a toast.

Great value. The sailboat is comfortable and there is space to move around freely. The walk is soothing and has a beautiful view of the sea and Barcelona. The host of the boat is welcoming and friendly.
A great few hours on a boat to get a unique view of Barcelona. Good value and tour is as advertised. Marc was very friendly and knowledgeable, and swimming in the Med was excellent!

This was a perfect way to experien e Barcelona. Even though all of the other passengers were half my age, I still had a wonderful time. Marc did a great job, I felt really safe and even dared to take a swim, despite my fear of sharks.
I highly recommend this trip if you're in Barcelona, money well spent!
A very worthwhile experience and a fab host. Brilliant views of the city line, great tunes and snacks, And a swim to cool off from the summer sun.
This was a magical experience! We were lucky enough to have smooth, glass-like waters for swimming. The boat ride and sunset views were incredible. This was a highlight of our 11 day Spain vacation.
Really great experience as a first timer sailing! The sunset ride is awesome because you get to swim while the sun is setting. I was at peace. Definitely recommend! Great music too!

A perfect sail on a perfect day. I booked this experience for myself and four friends on the last day of our girls’ trip to Barcelona. Each of them described our evening sailing and swimming as a highlight of the trip. It was amazing, and we felt comfortable and safe the whole time. Highly recommend!

The view was breathtaking! Sergio was an amazing guide and super accommodating.
The ride was bumpy at times (as expected) so would not recommend for folks who are prone to getting sea sick - however, Sergio was incredibly empathetic and accommodating when my mom was feeling queasy and made the trip a very enjoyable one. Would definitely do this again!

Lovely lovely day. Enjoyed meeting some new people, chilling out on the paddle board in the middle of the sea, watching the massive jellyfish as we boated by (don’t worry, there were none at all where we stopped to swim!), the awesome view, everything really. Could’ve spent another hour out on the water easily (would’ve made for 3 hours total). Thanks for a lovely experience!
I couldn’t recommend this more. We loved the sail from start to finish & was a great way to start off our honeymoon

This was one of our best thing we ever did! Marc is a cool and nice guy honestly. We booked the sailtrip at 6pm and had a awesome view of Barcelona. Marc said, today is not allowed to swim because of some "rough" waves. He asked, if we want to, we can reschedule or get money back or to sail out without swimming. We left the harbor and it was more than perfect! big thanks to the captain we had so much fun and it was worth every moment, we had perfect wind, sun and bounce waves. You will meet new people and listen to the stories of Marc about Barcelona and the ocean. Cool drinks, music and some tapas with friends and the captain was simply the best. I'm sure everyone enjoyed this trip as well, except one of the guys, he had some sangria before :)
10/10

Great boat tour that quickly gives you an understanding of the Barcelona skyline and different neighborhoods. Sergio and Olga were super friendly and accommodating. Was very refreshing to take a quick dip as well.

The sailing trip itself was great, and Marc was super nice and accommodating. The trip includes some nice snacks (Spanish ham, cheese) as well as some beer and cava. Highly recommend this experience for anyone who wants to get out on the water in Barcelona and have a great view of the city and surroundings.

This is a must do when in Barcelona. Marc was a super host and tour guide and my friend who celebrated her birthday felt like a VIP this entire time. Thank you Marc. Your insights, cheer and fun conversations made this trip extra special.

There was such a funny and Perfectly spent time to See Barcelon in See side!! I am totally recomendet. We had drinks, snack, some explaning of places in Barca of course was many time to swimming and playing in water. Such a grat time!

This was really fun! It was lovely to see a different view of the city. Marc was a charming host- played good music, offered yummy snacks and drinks, shared personal stories and and told us what was happening at each step!
The experience was amazing we had so much fun! The host was great. This is a must in Barcelona, you get to see the city from a different prospective and the views were spectacular.

Beautiful experience on the sailboat, we drove out a bit to see Barcelona from a distance, stayed there briefly and drove back - always with motor. It was nice, but also not particularly spectacular. A little bit like a treadmill

An amazing experience! I went solo, but by the end of it made some wonderful new friends. The vibes, the relaxing nature, the views of the city absolutely amazing! highly recommend if you want to experience swimming far out in the deep blue!
Beautiful boat, fun drinks, and amazing clear water. Seeing Barcelona from the water is a must do. Definitely a highlight of trip getting to swim in that clear, beautiful water!
This is an amazing experience to book if you’re looking for an authentic guide, new friends, and a different way to explore Barcelona!
This was recommended to us by a friend and I’m so glad we did it! We had so much fun and thought it was the perfect amount of time on the water and it was greeting making new friends!
we are happy to have taken this trip on board.❣️🥰💓🎉 Marc is a great person. Thanks for that definitely 💫 want to do it again. We recommend anyone coming to Barcelona to take this sailing tour. 💗👍👍👍👍

We had fun and were able to get in the water. The hosts were great, and they also had a tube and paddle board. The other guests on the tour were nice too which made the experience even more enjoyable.

This boat trip was incredible! Marc was a fabulous host with the most interesting stories! We were entertained for hours. He went above and beyond to make sure we had a great time and it was nothing short of wonderful. Definitely a must-do in Barcelona!
Enjoyed the ride with drinks and snacks :) Marc took us to a nice spot to see the entire Barcelona skyline and shared with us some interesting facts:) It was a nice experience:)
Nice trip, originally I had scheduled for the afternoon but the trip was rescheduled to next day morning cuz of bad weather, so in the morning there was no sailing per se, all in all was a good trip.

The experience is superb, the skipper and Miss Sarah are all very nice, and in the end, it was a great experience to take pictures with tourists from all over the sea.
The azure sea sparkles at sunset, returns to Barcelona's long stretch of coastline from the sea, and the sun shines through the clouds, along with the company of three dolphins, for an unparalleled experience!!!
Very nice trip. Sergio was considerate when my friends feel seasick. Unluckily we cant swim in the sea, but I totally like it.

We loved the experience. Mark was really Nice and listened to our needs. Drinks and snacks and good conversations. And we saw dolphins!!! With big waves Not really for the ones with the weak stomach. 😅 But okay if You can handle that! Reccomend to book.
We had unusually big waves. Swimming would have been unsafe, so we were given the options to rebook. Glad we didn’t. My kids loved it.

The sail with Marc was fantastic. Beautiful boat, lovely location and a good time by all. It was fun to see Barcelona from the water and meeting a few new people was great. Finally a dip in that beautiful sea was special on a hot summer day.

Very nice both Sergio and Marc, 100% recommended and repeatable experience. We were warned that that day there would be a stronger wave than usual and they gave us the option to postpone it, but we wanted to do it anyway and it was all very fun and enjoyable, better than we imagined. We'll be back for sure!

We had a great time out on the water with Marc!! He plays great music and made us feel very comfortable. The group was small - only 9 people. The water wasn’t too rough, but definitely take some Dramamine if you’re prone to seasickness. We booked the sunset tour and the waves were larger on the way back. The water was too rough and weather was a bit too cold to swim, but you get fantastic views of the sunset behind the city. This was truly an amazing experience and I would recommend it to anyone visiting Barcelona!!

This experience was well worth the money! Marc was an incredible skipper and told us all about the city of Barcelona. We got beautiful views of the city from the ocean, swam for about 30 minutes and enjoyed some champagne and beer. Would highly recommend 10/10
absolutely amazing time with great people! the views are breathtaking and the hosts are absolutely fantastic. one of my favorite trips ever, especially for the value!
Great esperienze!! wonderful city seen by the sea. Very thought full crew and amazing music. We were on a hen and eveything was so special ! I highly recommend !!

This was a nice experience to get away from the city and into the water! They also let my friend take a ride on the tube which was super fun for her as well. Overall a fun activity to do on a sunny day!

Amazing experience, I already wanna rebook and go again! If you are thinking about it, I suggest booking it before it books up cause it is well worth your money and the hosts were amazing making it a memorable experience

It's an excellent plan if you want to meet new people in Barcelona and enjoy the sea. Sometimes couples, girls and guys in groups or individuals go. Good for meeting people and strengthening English. The host gives snacks, drinks (beer or soda) and has all the safety items to throw into the ocean, floats, surfboard, vests, etc. Good music and company.

Wonderful afternoon. Fun and relaxing. The water and swim are spectacular! The water and sailing are smooth. The Cava went down easy and the other people on the boat (small group) were so friendly. Marc was also a great host. Was so sad when it was over! A must do!

These guys were amazing! For two hours or more you get sailing the Mediterranean, you can’t beat the value. The skipper and first mate were awesome. Average to above average English with great suggestions on the city and eating around the port.

Once out to sea you can swim and paddle board or sunbathe, it’s entirely up to you.

Overall recommend this company and the afternoon sailing. It’s the highest rated in the area for a reason 😁

Really great and fun experience. I loved the swimming experience there such a blue water😍💦🏊 there was no real sailing because there was not enough wind, but it was a good experience overall with a great view on Barcelona.

it was a great trip ,, the team Sara and the Captin Jan was so cheerful and helpful, will recommend everyone to go for this trip . And all the trip mates was nice people ,, Thank you all and see you sooooon . 💙

This is a must-do while in Barcelona! Such a unique way to enjoy the city. Sergio was a wonderful host, providing all the snacks and drinks you’d like. He’s also incredibly knowledgeable about sailing and Barcelona. We loved taking a dip in the ocean and felt safe the entire time. All this for a totally fair price. Thank you, Sergio!

We had the most wonderful time with an intimate group of people sailing around the gorgeous waters of Barcelona and had a wonderful, refreshing swim too! Sergio was an excellent host who provided us with background stories, history and recommendations of Barcelona as well as excellent cava, queso and jamón! The entire group gelled so well and we made wonderful new friends from this experience, we only wished the sail was for longer !

10/10 would do again. Sergio is such a great host and delivers a proper experience. His boat is well equipped with everything you need and the deep waters were beautiful! Also helps that the group we were with was super friendly as well.

SO MUCH FUN! A great way to spend an afternoon in Barcelona. Learned about the city from a local, got to swim in the beautiful sea, and end with a lovely cava toast. Marc went out of his way to make sure we had a good time, always laughing, with great photos. 10/10 would recommend.

My first time swimming in the Mediterranean was incredible. I highly recommend this experience if traveling solo as it allowed me to share time with other people and enjoy time in the water away from all the people at the beach.

Marc was great, shared a lot of interesting things about the cities. He suggested places to go, things to do, and even through in a little life advice! We had such a great experience, best way to experience the Mediterranean.
This was a great experience! Got to learn more about Barcelona from the sea, enjoy beautiful views, and swim in the ocean for a bit.
We had a great afternoon on Marc’s sailboat! We especially enjoyed the snacks (fuet, manchego, etc.). A perfect way to enjoy Barcelona’s coast!
Excellent experience. The guide was super attentive that we were all enjoying the moment. You can see the entire city from a different perspective.

What a perfect way to escape the hustle and bustle of city life (and a summer heat wave)! Sergio was an engaging and super fun captain, with a gorgeous boat that provided sun, shade and jaw dropping views of Barcelona. We loved the ability to swim in the warm waters of the Mediterranean while also getting a different view of beautiful Barcelona. We also loved meeting the other participants - what a great group of people to share such a beautiful day with! The two hours on the boat was just the right amount of time and we all loved the ability to relax away from the crowds of the city. Thank you Sergio and Lauren for a really wonderful time!
Was a wonderful experience and they were very accommodating! Would highly recommend taking part in this and enjoying the experience the same way I did ☺️

Even though the experience lasts only two hours, it can feel like a full fun day out at sea. The hosts are very calm and patient - they take you to the middle of the sea and let you jump off to swim without urging you to get back soon. There's almost no other boat at the swim spot so it feels super private. My only tip would be to carry your own sea sickness remedies as they don't have anything readily available on the boat.

This sailing experience was beyond all of our expectations! The meet-up instructions were clear, the staff was very friendly, and the boat was BEAUTIFUL! We stopped for about 20 minutes to swim in the ocean and try out the paddle board. Our hosts provided some drinks and snacks, too! Overall, I highly recommend!
We had a lovely trip out into the waters. The swim was very refreshing. There were tasty snacks, a small group and a super nice skipper.
Loved our trip with Jean. He was smart and witty and answered all our questions about the boat and the area! Would definitely do it again.
Fun trip, if you like to relax and just enjoy the view with your friends this is a good opportunity! Nice staff, and really good skipper ⛵️

Great experience. My friends and I enjoyed it. Super relaxing and fun. I only wish I had jumped into the water sooner. I was scared the water would be too cold and only had little swim time by the time I jumped in. Our hosts had many recommendations on places to eat, dance and visit. Definitely recommend! Thank you for the great experience!

This cruise was a great time! Fun to see Barcelona from the water and swim in the refreshing water.

When we boarded we weren't sure if 2 hours was enough but it was perfect. Swimming was the highlight but it's tiring further out in the water.

Marc put Spanish party music on and everyone had fun.
It was an amazing experience. We were able to swim in the wonderful waters. I believe our guide was David and he was knowledgeable and concerned for safety of all aboard. I would book this again

Big thank you to Marc and co for making my boyfriends surprise birthday boat trip amazing! It was a cloudy morning but we still had a great time, and Marc was great when our friend got seasick too! Lovely guys, beautiful boat, can play your own music! Defo recommend!
It was a lifetime experience. The sailing was comfortable and smooth with lot of stories about Barcelona. We will sail with them again if we come to Barcelona again. Most recommended!
Great trip to have a different view and experience of Barcelona! Sergio was super caring to all of us in regards to where to swim, drinks & food. Very much recommendable!

It was such an amazing experience. Beautiful weather and an amazing view of Barcelona. With some nice music we made our way alongside the cost and enjoy conversation and some tapas with Cava. Would for sure come back when I visit Barcelona for an other time in the future.
Super amazing experience! I highly recommend - great vibe, beautiful sunny day, big and beautiful boat, swimming and glass of cold cava. What can be better? :)
Great time today with the crew! Enjoyed the stories and learning more about the city. Beautiful sailboat and great snacks and music! A+ highly recommend!!

This was such a fun experience for our first time in Barcelona! My husband jumped in the water when they gave us the opportunity to and he said it was so exhilarating. The hosts were accommodating with snacks and a bottle of cava for everyone to share.

Lovely afternoon. Marc was a warm host and conscientious captain. Just the right mix of narrative and conversation with quiet enjoyment of the sea. Definitely a five star experience. He even took time to retrieve an inflatable toy left floating in the water by some other thoughtless boat which we applauded. Clearly committed to the environmental health of the Mediterranean.

What could be better than going for a boat ride with two amazing guys and friends? Jumping into the refreshing waters of the Mediterranean and then being greeted with a glass of cava when you reboard the boat! We did the evening boat ride, and we were able to change into evening clothes under deck as we got back to the marina so we didn't have to go back home before going to dinner.

We had so much fun! Mark was so caring and fun energy- u could see he is enjoying what he does in life, I was afraid to enter the water at the sea and he was super sweet and thoughtful, and helped me jump inside the water, good vibe and great energy, the best day at my trip! Highly recommended!
This trip was great! The perfect amount of time and it came with snacks and drinks! I would definitely recommend and go on this tour again!

We, a group of 4 friends, really enjoyed our boattrip with Sergio. He is a very friendly, reliable guide. We felt safe and had a wonderful time! Also the communication in advance with him and his wife was very uncomplicated and always on time. Any time again, really recommend!

This trip was really excellent! Marc was such a great host and the boat had loads of space so felt really chilled. Would 100% do this again next time just for the laugh and excellent company. Book this trip now. 👍👍😁
Fun way to get out of the city and out on the water. Boat is a nice size and keeps the tour feeling personal. Our host was friendly and accommodating. Would do again!
Highly recommend if you want to get on the water! It was so beautiful and such a fun experience. Jump in the ocean if you can!
Highlight of our Barcelona trip! Met some new friends and had a beautiful day on the water, got some great pictures too :)

We went on the sailing adventure on a day when there was no wind and there was overcast.

Marc made us and the other group feel so comfortable. He provided amazing insight on our surroundings, fabulous food recommendations, and his own authenticity!

We loved the group we went with so that helped.

It was fun, comfortable, and memorable even if the weather didn’t accommodate!

Thank you Marc! Glad you’re living your happiest life!

This experience is the best i had in AirBNB, the location was amazing and i am lucky that the group was really fun to be with. David our sailor is really experienced and welcoming. Do not hesitate to take this trip it is worth it 100%

Super lovely day on the water with new friends! Marc kept us fed, hydrated (water, beer, and cava!)—and even had jackets ready for when the wind picked up! Would very much recommend; his love of the water is contagious!

Unique experience in Barcelona, very good treatment and very good vibe. I recommend this experience if you like the sea. They have music on the boat and a small picapica with cava if you want. Very good times, THANK YOU! :)

This boat experience was really great. The view of Barcelona from the sea is beautiful and Sergio was perfect, the welcome on his boat, the cruise and he even helped me pass my sea sickness:)
At this price it's really a perfect activity with friends and family

Sergio messaged me the day before to say that the trip was cancelled due to upcoming weather issues which is very understandable. He kindly offered alternative dates/times and was able to accommodate us that day. Sergio was friendly and welcoming, joining in the conversation and making us feel at home on his boat. Although the weather was quite cold and windy (and the sea was choppy), we still had a fun time. The food and drink was lovely and we were encouraged to help ourselves. The only thing that could improve the trip would be a warmer day!

My husband had a great time at the boat, he sailed for quiet sometime and also helped with the sail mast. Since the weather was cold we didn’t stop for the swim. We were provided with tapas and drinks as provided in the description. Overall a great value for money

I booked this experience at the last minute, thank you so much for accommodating me, after my previous boat booking cancelled. Marc was awesome! The stories, sightseeing, music and bubbles made this a great birthday trip. I felt like a rent a yacht for an afternoon seaside tour.
Such a fun trip and Sergio was very knowledgeable about a wealth of topics on the city during our experience. Had a blast and learned so much.

Really great experience! For us it was quite choppy (we were warned beforehand) and we decided to go ahead anyway and felt quite seasick which made the experience uncomfortable. However, communication from the host was great and I can easily see it being an amazing experience when the sea is calmer. The views of Barcelona are lovely and it definitely was worth it. Just a shame for us that the conditions were a bit difficult.
Amazing & relaxing experience. The views were amazing. Sergio was so kind and brought us snacks and drinks and played some chill music. Definitely recommend!
Sergio was absolutely lovely! Very relaxed and friendly…. We drank cava while lying in the sun on the top of the boat before jumping into the beautiful Barcelona waters!

We had a really great time with Sergio! The weather was beautiful, the sail boat was amazing, and Sergio was a really great host. The views on the sea were absolutely incredible and swimming by the boat was a really fun experience. Sergio shared a lot of stories and information with us about Barcelona's history and culture and sailing. It was a great addition to our trip and we'd love to do it again!

Wonderful sailing experience. Sergio was an incredible host. I was personally interested in learning more about sailing and to my luck, Sergio is a certified instructor. At the end I got to drive a bit and park the boat back )with Sergio’s instructions of course). I don’t think everyone gets that experience and I really appreciated it!
Wonderful experience with Sergio. Information regarding meet-up point was good so we had no problems finding the boat. He offered drinks and snacks, which was very nice and was friendly!

What an amazing experience. Sergio is such an amazing genuine human. You feel so comfortable in his presence and feels like going sailing with a friend. The views were amazing, swimming out to sea was so good, and just chilling and having a beer and chatting to Sergio was great, he even let me girlfriend take us back to port which was a lovely touch and experience.
Amazing hosts, and an amazing experience to have food and drinks all while enjoying the beauty of the sea with the views of Barcelona. 10 out of 10 recommended!
It was good! A beautiful calm day at sea, we went straight out and then back. I was a bit sea sick from traveling, but not from the boat itself.
Loved our sailing experience off the coast of Barcelona, everything was clean and safe. We enjoyed drinks, snacks and Cava. Thanks for an awesome experience!

It's amazing to see Barcelona from a different point of view. We could also enjoy some snacks and a swim in the sea.
Highly recommended!
It was all in all a good value for the money. David was very nice and extremely accommodating! We had the best view of Barcelona during the boat tour

Sergio curated a truly beautiful experience on the Mediterranean Sea. So lovely to see Barcelona from that view, enjoy blue waters, and make new friends along the way. Definitely worth the money would do it again in a heartbeat.
Amazing trip with Sergio. Had a lot of fun sailing, swimming, enjoying the water inflatables, and the snacks were amazing too. If you are in Barcelona, this is the trip to do!

Sergio was an excellent host, very welcoming and friendly. The boat is beautiful and was perfect for our group of 4. It was nice to join and meet other guests on the boat and the weather and views were beautiful. It was great to be able to stop and swim in the sea - unfortunately some of our group were seasick as the waves were a little high at times, but that can't be helped! Overall we'd definitely recommend and do it again - looking forward to our next trip to Barcelona.

Incredible experience! Myself and my partner had the best time on the boat with Sergio. He made us feel very comfortable and gave us some sailing tips too! An afternoon at sea, jumping off the boat into the warm clear water, drinking beer, playing on the paddle board and ring float! It was perfect. 100% recommend! Thank you Sergio and Olga
It was ABSOLUTELY INCREDIBLE!!! We jumped in the calm waters , had great laughs, and amazing energy. We were combined with another group and had so much fun we ended up joining them for lunch!

Had an amazing experience. First time on a sailboat - enjoyed every minute of it. Beautiful views and it was a lot of fun to take a dip in the Mediterranean. David was the guide for my trip and he did an excellent job, highly recommended!
Great experience! It was so much fun and I loved the small intimate group. The sparkling wine and beer were great too. Loved swimming in the water.

Amazing experience for an entirely different view of Barcelona! Loved getting out on the water, we were slightly unlucky that it was a really windy day and the sea was quite rough, but still a great experience!

This was AMAZING!!! I had probably one of the best experiences of my life with this, totally worth it! And definitely worth the price. Had a huge main character moment standing at the front of the sail boat. Definitely take some motion sickness pills beforehand just to be sure! But I highly recommend

This was an amazing experience, lots of new things to know about Barcelona an sea it self.
Our captain was amazing. Unfortunateley a bit confused with the name.. Marco or Mario or.. 😅 He was amazing and made sure that we had the best time. We where able to sunbathe and swim in the open sea. I would recomend this. Every cent worth spending! 🤩❤️

This was one of my highlights in Barcelona. To be on a boat on the Mediterranean sea drinking a chilled beer and seeing the sights of Barcalona from a different view...fabulous. The swim in the sea was not as easy as I first thought but worth doing and ticking that box...
Overall a great 2 hours spent!

Thanks to Marc for his kindness and thoughtfulness. We were hosted very well and were able to enjoy the boat for 2 hours and swim off the coast. Drinks and snacks are much appreciated. A very good memory. 🙂
It was very cool, the yacht was in great condition and was very clean, the location was beautiful and the water was very nice as well
What a lovely company! We had such a fab time. Mark, our skipper, was a superstar and really looked after us. We went swimming, had a few drinks and thoroughly enjoyed ourselves - thank you!!

Very good plan! Perfect for taking a tour and seeing Barcelona from the sea. The sailboat is very spacious, they have donut and paddle surf, and you can play your music. Olga and Sergio were very attentive to time. Sergio was lovely the whole trip. Recommended!

Another person was interested in buying a sailboat in Barcelona and Sergio kindly shared his experience on buying boats. Some of us wanted to know more about the sailing resources in town and Sergio show us where the sailing center is after the tour. We stopped for a little bit during the trip so me and my mom went for a swim in the open water. Sergio’s boat is very well maintain and very comfortable. You can tell the passion he has for sailing.
Great experience! I recommend it to everyone to see Barcelona from a different perspective and enjoy the beauty of the sailboat. Thank you Sergio, we had a great time

We did the trip with the sailboat in the afternoon and absolutely loved it. The boat is big and comfortable, we had enough time to swim and sergio had floating animals and a surfboad available. He also provided water and softdrinks and cava and snacks. Overall it was a really nice trip and i would definitely recommend it! Thanks Sergio :)

Favorite part of our Barcelona trip and a great way to beat the humidity of the city! We sailed out for about 30 minutes before we anchored and had the opportunity to swim around the boat and try out floaties and a paddle board. Sergio showed us how to raise the sail on the boat and was happy to share details on what he was doing. On the way back towards the coast, he shared snacks and Champaign with us, beer was offered while we were swimming.
IT WAS A NICE EXPERIENCE FULL OF GOOD MOMENTS AND WITH THE GREAT KINDNESS OF SERGIO. WE WOULD DEFINITELY REPEAT.

I hired the walk with sergio to go on my birthday with the idea of doing something different. But that day was ugly and we couldn't get out. She offered to check out the next morning. It was an unforgettable experience Sergio and his friend Gonzalo made us feel super comfortable!!! , the sailboat is very nice and comfortable!!! I went with my partner, his daughter and the boyfriend.
We celebrated my birthday onboard . Sergio opened a cava to toast and served us snacks and beers. We bathed in the sea and were able to do stand up surfing. We had fun and laughed a lot! I would definitely do it again! I recommend it 100% , don't miss it if you're in Barcelona.
For me it was an unforgettable birthday!!!!

A really great experience! Despite the cloudy weather and a small amount of rain, Sergio managed to give us the full experience and make our trip fun. Sergio is a great host and sailing + swimming in the Mediterranean made my trip to Barcelona one to remember!

Great trip on a nice sailboat - no wind so we couldn't actually sail but it was fun nonetheless. He has inner tubes and stand up paddle boards and gave us plenty of time to swim. They also provided yummy snacks, cava, beer and water. Overall a fun way to spend a few hours on the water in Barcelona!

This was a great experience!!! We were a bit disappointed at first because it was raining at the beginning but that made the sky and the sunset absolutely stunning afterwards!! This experience was incredible, Sergio and his wife were extremely nice and made us feel welcome on their boat. Would do it again!

The slightly-cloudy weather didn’t affect this amazing experience. Our host was very friendly and thoughtful, we had snacks and champagne after jumping into the sea(just when we need it) while sitting down and chatting with new friends. Overall, this is a very fun experience!

This experience was amazing starting with the welcoming from Olga to the great conversations with Pablo. Sergio was not present but his replacement (Pablo) did a great job. The boat itself was very clean just how introduced in the description and it was very easy to find. Everyone was very generous and we had an overall amazing time.

Sergio was not there for this cruise. His wife Olga was there and she was very pleasant. The man who skippered was nice but did not go out of his way to connect to any of us
This was our second boat experience of the week and the first one was much more interactive. We loved the experience but had more fun with a different skipper earlier in the week.

It was a great experience! We had too much fun, the welcome was super friendly and friendly! The music, champagne 🍾 and the beautiful atmosphere, we swimmed in the sea and it was too cool!
I highly recommend it.

Sergio’s boat trip was the perfect duration, relaxed (how can you not with inflatable unicorns) and experienced crew the trip was the perfect way to escape Barcelona for a dip in the Mediterranean.

I messaged Sergio to say I was vegan and they made sure they had a range of snacks ready for me to eat alongside the more traditional meats and cheese.
Lots of fun! A great way to spend a beautiful day in Barcelona. Olga was very friendly, the boat was beautiful, and the experience was awesome!

All i can say is WOW! It was truly the highlight of the trip. Sergio and his wife were wonderful people. Knowledgeable, hospitable and kind. We felt so welcome and safe. We wished we could have sailed with them longer. If you are in Barcelona, you must do this!

This experience was amazing and I highly recommend! The boat was easy to find with Sergio's instructions. They are extremely knowledgeable about sailing and Barcelona. Being able to stop and swim was wonderful and getting to steer the boat was the cherry on top!
Thank you Sergio for this incredible experience! My husband and I really enjoyed it, it was definitely one of the highlights of the trip! Thank you for the cava and the snacks too :)

I had the best time! It was such a beautiful experience. Sergio is wonderful and hospitable! It was a wonderful way to see Barcelona. The water was crystal clear, it was such a dream. ! You won't regret it!
Very awesome experience! My group of 7 were very happy with all of it. Sergio was very knowledgable and stopped the boat 2 times so we could swim. He also had beers and snacks for us. 10/10 overall!
Everything was perfect; the setting, the atmosphere, the aperitifs etc!! A very nice time unfortunately spent quickly with pleasant people. To be repeated without hesitation:)
It was an amazing experience. I loved the flow of the experience. Sailing swimming, drinks and spanish snacks with awesome hosts and a great group of people.
My nephew proposed to his girlfriend while onboard (she said yes!) and they broke out some champagne for us and the other passengers. It was a wonderful experience!

So happy I booked this experience for me and my best friend! This was a perfect way to spend our last day in Barcelona. Sergio made everything stress-free by communicating with us the day before and by responding quickly to any questions we had. The beautiful boat (equipped with fun inner tubes and paddle boards) was super easy to find once we arrived at the port. Jumping off the boat into the gorgeous Mediterranean Sea was definitely a highlight of our trip. Our only wish is that we got to swim for a little longer before popping open the cava and heading back to shore! I would definitely book this experience again. Highly recommend!

This was awesome. Perhaps our favorite thing in Barcelona. We had a blast on the boat, they served us snacks and drinks but otherwise were not overbearing in the least. A delightful time that I can’t recommend enough. We also made friends with other folks on the boat.
Such a unique and grand way to see Barcelona with the ability to swim in the Mediterranean outside of the beaches. Plus the crew and the boat are brilliant.

This is an amazing experience for anyone visiting Barcelona. The views were incredible, the water clear as day, and the time on the boat was fun and relaxing. A must-do if you want to get the most out of Barcelona

We had a fantastic time on Sergio’s boat. They were so friendly and experienced. We swam in the Mediterranean Sea and enjoyed the spectacular sunset over Barcelona. It’s a great experience you won’t forget, highly recommend it!!!
Great trip, really friendly and knowledgeable hosts. Beer, cava and delicious snacks were provided. Chilled out relaxed atmosphere. Would definitely recommend to anyone going to Barcelona.

My daughter and I had a wonderful experience swimming in the Mediterranean. So much so that we returned later in the day and went out again! Sveta and Max were friendly and accommodating. Highly recommend

My boyfriend and I had an amazing experience on Sergio’s boat!! We were met by Max and a lady (who’s name I can’t remember) and felt welcome right away! Although the weather wasn’t the greatest we still had amazing views of Barcelona from the sea and had a quick splash around before having some lovely tapas and got the taste for the local cava. Would 100% recommend.

Great experience

The ship was easy to find in the port and the host was very welcoming! The captain and deckhand both made an effort to introduce themselves and find a bit more about all the people on the ship.
There were unlimited refreshments whilst on the ship and a good chunk of time was also spent swimming out at sea.
I was allowed to also steer the ship back to the port whilst being instructed by the captain which was a unique experience!!
Overall a great trip with everything you could’ve asked for, I would definitely do it again!
Really lovely sunset trip on Sergio's yacht! Sergio and his wife were the perfect hosts - generous and friendly but also gave us space to enjoy the sunset and the sea.

This sailing trip was a great experience. Sergio and his wife were so kind, welcoming, and friendly. They provided ample beer and snacks and it was a great way to get out of the city and relax for a few hours and meet new people. Overall I loved it and highly recommend it!
We only wish we could have spent more time! Such a lovely experience, perfect for the middle of a hot day and we loved the escape.

Had an absolutely wonderful time - a perfect way to spend an afternoon in the sweltering Barcelona heat. The hosts are incredibly friendly - great conversations all around. They even had a paddleboard!

We had such a great time sailing with Sergio. He makes you feel so welcome on his boat and is extremely accommodating. We sailed out of the port and our whole group jumped in the ocean to go swimming. So much nicer than swimming at the crowded beaches. Sergio had floats, and a paddle board, and all the fun stuff. We had champagne on the way back and all the (Hidden by Airbnb) able pictures were taken ;) Such a blast!

I have terrible sea sickness and decided to go anyway because my mom and brother really wanted to go. I definitely was sick on the boat but Sergio was attentive and made sure he did whatever he could to make me feel better, which I really appreciated. My family loved this experience, it is very easy to find the boat & champagne over looking water is always a good idea.

This was such a fun experience. My boyfriend and I chose the 8pm-10pm tour and we got to see the BEAUTIFUL sunset. We had the chance to swim, they had snack, drinks, floaties for the ocean. It was beautiful, very a calm and the hosts were great. Very nice, genuine and simply wanted you to have a great time. This was one of our highlights in Barcelona!
Amazing experience - definitely worth it to escape the hot barcelona sun! The snacks/drinks were perfect and it was great to cool down in the sea breeze/take a dip in the water

My husband and I booked this experience on the advice of some coworkers who sailed with Sergio he year before. We were told so many great things about him so we went in with high expectations. Sergio met these expectations and more. He is friendly and personable. He was extremely welcoming and made us feel at home. As we chose the morning hours, we were the only two people on the boat, but rather than feel awkward or out of place, we felt as though we had known Sergio forever! I highly recommend this experience to everyone. Sergio is an amazing host, and We could not have asked for a better experience.
Recommended. With a dip in the sea, excellent views, friendly and accommodating hosts and a lovely group, you can only feel comfortable
We had a wonderful time on Sergio’s boat! It was super relaxing and we got to go swimming then enjoy some snacks. We had a wonderful time!

This was the most magical experience, we were made to feel super welcome and safe. The hosts were unbelievably welcoming and kind. 100000% recommend! Definitely something needed to be experienced. Unreal, thanks for the best time! Snacks and drinks were yummy too x

Had hoped to do some actual sailing versus “motor sailing.” Wind was light but sailboat did not have a suitable jib for light air. Otherwise a very pleasant boat ride with opportunity to swim and paddle board. Did not get to meet original host, Sergio as he was double booked on another boat. Max and Svbeta were great hosts.

Taking a sailboat and swimming in the Mediterranean was a once in a lifetime experience. Sergio was friendly, knowledgeable, and attentive to everyone's needs. I was even able to steer the boat! Highly recommended!

This is a very nice 2 hour experience. Beautiful sailboat, positive guide and overall great time. Jumping in the water, swimming around and then snacking with come Brut Cava. Very chill time. We ended up doing this before having to go to the airport for one last taste of Barcelona and we are very pleased. Thank you, Sergio :)

Really special experience. Sergio was very knowledgeable, friendly, and accomodating. The boat was amazing. The water was literally crystal clear. We had an amazing time swimming, sipping on super nice local Cava (bought a case on the way out), and met some lovely travellers as well. Highly, highly recommended.

Nice sailing excursion from Barcelona. Just remember to take motion sickness medicine if you are prone to getting seasick! Luckily the hosts were nice enough to give me tips on how to feel better and provided blankets to make me more comfortable.

This boat ride experience went beyond our expectations. The sail boat was beautiful, the group was small, the staff was extremely friendly and we were served lots of drinks and snacks. Plus we got to jump into the Mediterranean. Great two hours. Overall highly recommend.

Amazing experience... had a great morning with Sergio and the other guests. He is very friendly and made us feel welcome. We enjoyed sailing and swimming in the Mediterranean and had a very chill time. Would definitely return the next time I'm in Barcelona!
Incredible experience -- Sergio is a great host! He knows how to make his guests feel as comfortable as possible on his sailboat.

Wow! What can I say? My first time sailing like this and my first time swimming in the Mediterranean, thanks to Sergio, made this event one of the highlights of my stay in Barcelona!

Sergio’s genuine and warm personality makes it all a chill atmosphere to enjoy this event even more; everything from the personal stories he has to share and the fun you have while you’re on the sea makes it all worthwhile!

Highly recommend this if you’re here in Barcelona!

Great trip out sailing with the opportunity to go for a swim. We had some lovely conversations, and just a really good time. All instructions ahead of time were very clear and the boat was easy to find. Would definitely recommend.
It was the loveliest experience! Svetlana and Max is an amazing crew, who can create the right mood! We were sunbathing, swimming in the sea, enjoying Spanish Cava! Really good! Highly recommend!

It was an amazing and unique experience! Thanks Max and the gorgeous blond Russian lady next to him who made this experience incredible! The music, snack, the Catalan champagne and the cool vibes, everything was perfect! Thank you guys!!
Great experience. Boat was clean, large, and comfortable. I felt very safe and the area we sailed through was just beautiful. Our captain was kind and knowledgeable. Definitely recommend.

This was our first air bnb experience and it exceeded my expectations! What’s not to love about sailing the coast and being able to dive into the beautiful Mediterranean! Sergio was a kind and gracious host, met some other wonderful guests and played in the ocean! Best experience we had in Barcelona and I highly recommend it, especially for those with kiddos! My daughter loved it!
We love the trip with the boat, it was an amazing Experience. Sergio an his wife were very friendly people :-) thanks for this unforgettable time!

This was our FAVORITE experience during our long weekend visiting Barcelona! Highly recommend. Sergio gives very good directions so that you are able to find the boat and then once on the boat, there was plenty of room for everyone in the group and we could spread out from the front to the back and could be separate from the group if we wanted to be. Sergio served drinks and delicious tapas during the sail and also stopped for a while to let people swim, paddle board or use a floaty. He has a lot of knowledge to share about the city and places to visit and is very friendly. Don't miss out!
My cousins and I had a blast aftroon! We were pampered and enjoy our quit afternoon after a long night hehe.. thank you Sergio!
100% recommended. A unique experience that I would live again with Sergio. The boat is top notch. Their attitude towards amazing people. Excellent vibe!!! It's a MUST if you come to Barcelona

This experience was fantastic! We had just the best time sailing and swimming off the boat. The snacks were great, the drinks plentiful, and the boat was a delight. My niece got to paddle boat which she was wanting to do this entire trip. We wish we had more time in Barcelona to do it again! Definitely recommended.

Very kind host with a very friendly attitude! My husband and I joined a group that traveled out and swam for a bit. Sergio even let the child drive the boat a majority of the ride! The snacks were delicious, including a local sausage and cava! If you’re looking for a relaxing ride, this is the experience you want.

Sergio is fantastic. He welcomed us and almost treated us as his friends. He is friendly, caring and experienced. We sailed and found a spot where we could swim. Along the way, Sergio gave us information about the city of Barcelona, the buildings by the beach and fishing boats we could see passing by ... Before heading back, Sergio surprised all of us with a selection of delicious local cheese, champagne and olives... I forgot to say that I took my 8 years old son with us, the kid had a blast, thanks to Sergio! It was really fun, a real experience. Sergio is the best!

That was one of the greatest sea experiences I ever had. Sergio was very helpful. I felt really like the boat was mine :D . The ambiancewas so chill. All the guests were feeling good so that helped us to know each other very easily! I would for sure recommand to sail with Sergio. I will do it next time I come to Barcelona!!!

Absolutely amazing!! Would recommend to anyone & everyone! The best experience I’ve had in Barcelona. Sergio is wonderful, kind & charming. The boat is lovely and safe. Swimming in the waters, eating snacks. Everything about this experience is wonderful. A must do with Sergio! We were booked for an evening, the waters were bad & choppy. He messaged us asking if we’d want to reschedule for better weather. We were able to and he had availability the next morning. So grateful for his advice & flexibility allowing us to get the full experience!
A very nice sailboat, with some fun touches like floaties, waterboard and good local cheeses, hams and cava. Above all, the host was very friendly and helpful.

DEFINITELY don't hesitate to go on this boat ride! This was a fantastic experience to be able to see the city from the sea. My friend and I had an excellent time with Sergio and the other guests. He was incredibly personable and accommodating.
Great experience, really chilled out and relaxing. Sergio is a great host, friendly and professional. Nothing was too much trouble. If you e not booked it already do it now

Must go experience! Sergio was wonderful: kind, attentive, and thoughtful! The whole time was wonderful. His boat is a great size, big enough to spread out but not so big that you can't sit in a group and talk if you want. It was a very relaxing time and absolutely gorgeous views! Sergio provided us with water, cerveza, chips, cheese, meat, bread, and cava! He had personally picked out and prepared the snacks and they were so tasty! We got to sun bathe, swim, and had a wonderful conversation (with Sergio and the other guests). Overall, an amazing time! Would absolutely go again.

100% recommend this experience. Even if for only 2 hours, it was the cherry on top of our time in Barcelona. Sergio & Svetla were warm & welcoming. I’d go again with them the next time I visit Barcelona!
Sergio was wonderful! The trip was amazing. Being on the water in Barcelona was truly a great experience! I recommend this to anyone looking for something fun to do while in Barcelona!
Sergio was a wonderful host! Not only did we have a great time out on the water, but we also got to learn a little about sailing.

What an amazing adventure! We had such a great time on our cruise out beyond the busy city, it was a real treat. Sergio was great and so fun and friendly! Would definitely recommend this to anyone visiting Barcelona. Thanks Sergio!

This experience was amazing!! Sergio made everyone feel so comfortable and was such a great captain! He taught us a few things about how to sail and even let us drive the boat. He was prepared with beer, water, soda, and cava! Did this when I was traveling alone and ended up making a great friend on the boat and hung out with her for the remainder of my trip. This was my favorite day when I was in bcn! Would definitely do it again!

It was wonderful, I had a very unique view of Barcelona and was able to even sail the boat for while. Swimming in the open sea was also an incredible experience. Sergio is very knowledgeable and nice to everyone. I would recommend this experience to anyone.
Sergio was so welcoming and kind! His boat was beautiful and we felt very relaxed. It felt like we were sailing with old friends. I would definitely recommend sailing with Sergio!

An absolutely amazing experience! We had a beautiful day on the water and went swimming, floating, and paddle boarding. The cava and snacks on the boat were perfect. We ended up sharing the boat with some awesome people and hung out together for the rest of the day! I would definitely recommend this experience to everyone! Sergio was very friendly and knowledgeable. Thanks for everything Sergio!

Unbelievably awesome!!! I was traveling solo and was worried about signing up as the 9th person on an already almost full tour - dang I’m glad I did. Ended up bringing my guitar and we jammed out while sailing - I made great friends with 6 of the other visitors and we spent the rest of the entire day having a blast, I feel like I made lifetime friends as a result of this little 2 hour tour! Worth every penny and I highly recommend it!!!!
They have a beautiful boat that is really fun to go out in. My sister and I felt doted on and cared for the whole time. It was a great way to see another perspective of Barcelona.
Sergio provides a great experience! This boat ride was a highlight from our time in Barcelona. Seeing the city from the sea and jumping in the Mediterranean are memories to be kept forever!
The trip was amazing, Max and Olga were both super pro, welcoming and we enjoyed the sea, the cava and some great talks - wish it would have been longer :) very recommendable!

Sailing the Mediterranean with friends and a great host on a beautiful boat on a beautiful day doesn't get much better. Highly recommended experience. I didn't want it to end! I will do this again for sure one day. Thanks Sergio, Olga and Max!

I recommend this boat ride to everyone. I met Sergio's partner and she was perfect: very prepared, friendly, nice, talking to her was a real pleasure. It is the type of experience that allows you to connect with one (or more) different culture through Sergio and his experience and the people you meet on board.

If I could have rated them higher, I would have. A phenomenal experience that my friends and I will remember forever. We got to take pictures, drink, chat, swim, paddle board, and more! Thank you from the bottom of my heart!

I definitely recommend it!!
Cozy boat, wonderful views, champagne and delicious snacks..., you see the city very differently than being on the shore. Special thanks to Olga, the wife of Sergio, thanks to her you feel like you're staying with friends.
Very good experience! It's a pleasure to have another view of the city, accompanied by music, snacks and champagne. I felt very comfortable with the hosts. Thank you so much!

The sailing experience with Sergio was excellent. When other people that booked did not show up (were running extremely late), Sergio made sure that I was comfortable going on the sailing trip with just myself and him, and offered other times for me to participate if I preferred. I was fine with the 1 on 1 experience, so I ended up getting a private sailing experience !

Sergio was super attentive to my needs through the whole experience (including when I got a smidge seasick after using the bathroom below deck) and we ended up having great conversations about Barcelona, sailing and our travel experiences in general.

Sergio is clearly an expert sailor and I felt very safe on the boat. Also had some excellent meats, cheeses and bread - was offered vermut and cava but due to aforementioned slight seasickness I stuck to coca cola :P

Can highly recommend this experience to anyone!
We had an amazing time sailing with Sergio! Not only he taught us how to sail, but he also served us Cava! Highly recommended for anyone in Barcelona!

Sergio was a true professional and gentleman - provided the ultimate sailing experience. Would recommend for everyone! The waters were choppy in the morning, Sergio reached out and recommended we moved out time.. great guy!

This was the most memorable part of my time in Barcelona. Sergio and his wife were incredible hosts, they were laid back, calm and welcoming to everyone. They know a lot about Barcelona and Spain and it was so interesting to learn from them. The boat is FABULOUS and Sergio really cares that you have a great experience. He’s also very good about making sure you know where to find his boat beforehand.

This was an unforgettable experience and I’m so happy I did it while in Barcelona.

Great activity!! Sergio was very kind and attentive. He offered to go test the waves before the activity to get an idea since the wind was strong. Beautiful anecdotes and explanations in progress. Delicious snacks!
Sergio was very friendly and knew so much about the city! We got a unique perspective from the water and had a great time.

This was an amazing experience for anyone who wants to go sailing while in Barcelona! Sergio is so nice, thoughtful, and genuinely wants you to have the best experience possible! His guests’ are his top priority! He made us feel welcome before we even came aboard :) highly recommend!!

Lovely experience to get out of the city and onto the water, seeing it from a different angle. The hosts were really kind and friendly and the swim and drinks added special value. All in all a wonderful afternoon to relax.

Fantastic experience. Sergio is a terrific host friendly and welcoming, who makes you feel at home on his boat. Tailored our trip to what we had in mind

Highly recommend !

Thanks mate .

Book this trip! We had the best time sailing with Sergio. The boat is beautiful and comfortable. Sergio is from Barcelona and graciously shared insight answering all our questions about the city/area, making suggestions for our visit/future visits. We chose to jump in the water even though it was cold and warm towels were provided when we finished. We enjoyed snacks and cava, beautifully set up. The amount of time was perfect to relax and see the city in a different way while still allowing us time to sight see by foot in the afternoon. We would definitely go back and would go with friends next time!
Excellent experience! The walk was very pleasant and Sergio's attention, kindness and professionalism left us a very good memory of Barcelona.

Fantastic day aboard Maggie May. Sergio , Olga and Max are super nice. We have been sailing in front of the Barcelona coast and participating at all times in sailing. When we docked, they offered us a good cava bite.
Required experience if you want to have another point of view of Barcelona and meet wonderful people
We'll be back for sure when we return!
Amazing experience, they were all very welcoming and they offered us champagne with snacks! They also offered us a blanket because of the cold weather! We really recommend this experience!

My group and I had such a wonderful time sailing with Sergio’s team. The boat was clean and had plenty of space for our group of 10. Such an awesome experience that we all enjoyed and would gladly reccommend to friends visiting Barcelona looking for a sailing trip. Thank you!!

What a wonderful morning sailing trip! Everything about Sergio’s experience surpassed my expectations. His boat is beautiful and has plenty of seating. I enjoyed hearing his sailing stories! Also i think 2 hours is the perfect amount of time. I took this experience alone and would book again! Sergio is such a great host and i highly recommend!

Sergio was a great host! we truly enjoyed the experience!! The boat is in excellent conditions, snacks and drinks were wonderful, and conversations with Sergio were great. Would def recommend this experience to anyone who wants to see Barcelona from a different perspective and enjoy a beautiful day at the sea.
Our host was very nice and engaging! His boat was beautiful and he told us lots of information about it. They were very welcoming and made us feel comfortable. I highly recommend!

The boat was very easy to spot as Sergio has a great parking spot close to the edge of the port. Sergio was very nice and it was clear he was a professional sailor. We were able to be involved in the sailing process and had the opportunity to swim in the water although none of us took it as it was too cold at the time of year. Sergio also brought out great local cheeses, meats, and cava. Highly recommend.

Wow!! Such an amazing experience!! This two hour sail trip is very private, beautiful and Sergio allows you to be as hands on or off as you like. Seeing Barcelona from the water is incredible and a must do experience. As a native of Barcelona, Sergio provided a lot of information about the city as well as giving us information about sailing. The cheese and cava were a lovely touch as well. You can definitely tell that he really loves what he does and he made us feel totally welcome on his beautiful boat!
We had a great time out on the sea! Unfortunately, the weather was less than ideal, but the view of the skyline was fantastic, and being out on the water was a blast!
Great experience! Sailing the coast of Barna with Cava and beers in good company. A couple of hours that they felt 20 minutes.

Everything was smooth sailing from start to end and whether you’re experienced with boating or just want to relax and go out to sea while getting some sun, this is the one to book! Loved this experience. Received information the night before with an image showing where the boat would be, in the end they were parked right at the start of the pier so it was really easy to find them. Olga (Sergio’s wife) was on board and she looked after everyone really well (checking if people wanted extra refreshments, lending me a jacket when i got cold without me asking, etc) and was a great conversationalist too! That makes a difference for a solo traveler like myself. We had snacks at the end along with champagne, besides that there’s soda and beer too. They had a paddleboard too you’re keen to try.

Sergio was wonderful! He was very welcoming and friendly and my husband and I were really impressed with his knowledge in Barcelona and his ability to show us all the major buildings. We had a blast! I got seasick, so Sergio brought me a coke to help my stomach which was so above and beyond of him and I’m so appreciative. We had a blast! Will do this again.
This is a must go accommodation. Sergio is very relaxed and nice. He lets you enjoy yourself on the boat as you please and he also lets you drive the boat. Thank you Sergio!

A unique experience! Sergio is a 10 host. Super attentive and very nice, she took care of everyone to make the trip the best possible and let us participate in the boat's tasks. Although the weather didn't go too far, it was a great experience. 100% recommended!

Went with my mother and sister and we absolutely loved it. The boat was easy to find, and when we arrived, the host were very friendly and offered us refreshments. We took off and they pointed out some places we could see from the ocean (Sagrada Familia, montjuic, etc ). As we had great conversation, they brought out snacks and cava. We got to see the beautiful Barcelona skyline and the hosts made sure we were comfortable the whole time. I would 100% recommend this to a friend and would do again in a heartbeat if I ever came back to Barcelona.

A perfect experience! Olga Sergio's wife hosted us and she was really very nice! We were able to enjoy a bright sun, the conversation was on, the dip in the cold but fun sea and the perfect snack! I do not regret participating in this enriching activity or I was able to enjoy an incredible view of Barcelona, a real pleasure that will remain a very good memory of Barcelona!

If you’re considering booking with Sergio and not sure if you should.... DO IT!! It was amazing and we are all so glad we decided to do this on our second to last day in Barcelona. Snacks, wine, beer and champagne were complimentary and he had fresh clean towels for us after a quick jump into the Mediterranean. I would book with him again without a doubt. His boat is the first one at the dock so extremely easy to find and a taxi can take you right to the dock if you’re not walking distance. There’s also restaurants outside of the Marina so you can make it a day trip. Sergio’s wife was also on the boat helping host and she is also amazing. Highly recommend!
The boat trip was perfect! It was a beautiful day. We relaxed, drank cava, saw Barcelona from a new perspective, and had fun conversing with the kind hosts. I highly recommend!

The trip was easy and enjoyable. There was an opportunity to communicate in Russian, which was very pleasant. The yacht is nice and clean. Very friendly attitude. Swimming. Had a good rest. Thank you. Recommended!

Great day!! Fantastic day sailing around Barcelona, sipping champagne, and jumping in the water. Wouldn’t have changed a thing! Super easy to find the boat and a very accommodating experience- thanks for an amazing day!

How lucky were my Dutch friend and me to be sailing with Sergio this weekend! The sun was out, the sea was super calm, there was a slight breeze in the air + we had our own private captain! On the way we saw a baby dolphin, super unexpected and amazing to see! Sergio prepared a Stand Up Paddle board for us, so we could enjoy the sea from up close, which was a super nice touch to this trip. Amazing and beautiful!! Sergio and his wife were so lovely and knowledgeable and made the ride smooth and sweet. Sergio knows a lot about the city and showed us everything. Although it was cold, the views were still beautiful. Will come back in the summer!! Muchas gracias!!

Book this trip!! You will not be disappointed.. I can promise that. I cannot tell you all how amazing this trip was, but will attempt to do my best!! Needless to say, the weather turned out to be great communication with Sergio was excellent he responded quickly and he was courteous reminding me that in this area waters can be unpredictable and weather can change within an hours notice. Sergio met me at the boat which is very easy to find, other people who had booked the trip did not show up however he did not cancel and I was able to enjoy the views as a solo guest. The boat itself is very clean and very nice and comfortable we did a brief orientation and set out for the afternoon, we had a nice chat while seeing the sights, and enjoying a beautiful day on the water. Sergio was kind enough to answer any and all questions I had about local cuisine, politics and the landscape. He pointed out key features in the skyline and we shared “fish stories” and had a few laughs along the way. By the end of the trip I was extremely satisfied and happy however I wanted more, so I continued with the next group of people it was very nice to spend time with others from around the country I was able to meet with Sergio‘s wife Olga, who was very kind and provided nice regional wine,cheese and meats. Overall I was extremely satisfied with my trip I would highly recommend to anyone, and I will most definitely return to visit my new friends in Barcelona!!! Thanks guys🙏💕 Muchas Gracias!!!!!!!

Sergio and Olga are amazing hosts! The night before they messaged the attendees with the detailed location of the boat. Once everyone’s on board, we set sail for the open waters of the Mediterranean. They made sure everyone had a beverage (whether that’s water, soda or beer) and they were very instructive about where it was ok to sit on the boat / what to look for along the Barcelona coastline. Once you get far out enough, it’s time to swim and keep in mind that the waters were very choppy on the day we went (if you’re not a strong swimmer, would highly recommend a life jacket). However, the water was a clear deep blue. It was gorgeous!! Sergio and Olga also provided floaties (a giant unicorn included) and we made sure to stay near the boat by holding onto a rope in the water. Had a fantastic time before Sergio announced it was time to head back. The sail back was fantastic. We even popped a bottle of cava. Sergio asked if anyone was interested in driving the boat and I jumped on the opportunity. Sergio and Olga were lovely welcoming hosts and I would highly recommend this is a day activity for anyone who loves sailing, outdoors and something a little different than just visiting museums/cathedrals/Gaüdi. *PS my sister got a little seasick on the trip and Sergio and Olga were amazing with her!

Thanks so much for the fantastic experience!!

Signed up at the last minute and I'm glad I did. Sergio and his wife are wonderful people with a beautiful sail boat. Thankfully we had great weather and the water was perfect for a dip in October. Definitely recommend the experience.

You do not want to miss this sailing excursion out into the beautiful Mediterranean Sea! Our guide, Chavi, was absolutely wonderful. Love him! This is a real sailing experience on a fabulous boat where you get to be in the endless blue ocean and swim in its incredibly gorgeous clear waters. Everything was provided; beer, cava, snacks, floaties. Chavi made sure we felt safe even when venturing out into the wild ocean. He tossed out lots of life support and kept an eye on us every second to insure that we were all staying above water. We put on goggles and swam around in the intensely blue waters. It is a truly existential thing, staring into those endless depths and being buoyed by the beautiful salty sea. Chavi gave us so much great info, pointed out all the cool sights on the shoreline, and told us all about the surrounding areas. The only thing I regret is that I did not take a Dramamine before we went out. I get very sea-sick and did not really think ahead in that respect, so I was sad I missed some of the best parts of the experience because I didn't feel well, but that is no fault of anyone but me. The rest of my friends were fine because they don't have the tender stomachs that I have. If you have a tendency towards sea-sickness, definitely make sure to take something so that you can enjoy every minute of this awesome excursion. I would really love to do this again, and next time I will take measures so I don't have to be the baby!

This was a really nice outing and a must do when visiting Barcelona! We had a great time! They provided drinks, refreshments and towels! You don’t want to miss this experience!

No dolphins were seen, but the Trip was great, the weather & water was beautiful! It was really windy so the water was very choppy. I would advise you take anti-nausea beforehand. Almost everyone on the boat felt seasick - overall, im glad we booked this experience.

It was really nice. A super nice activity with a very nice captain, full of care.
Thank you so much for this time!

What a great experience! With less than 10 guests on the boat it felt you were on a private tour. The crew was super nice and very accommodating. If you are looking for a little adventure and a fun time... this will be for you!

Sergio was fantastic! The sailing activity was well organized, very fun, and we felt very safe! Sergio provided detailed information about how to meet him at the boat before the event. The drinks and snacks were much appreciated as well. It is light snacks, but there is plenty for the group. I would not hesitate to recommend this activity to anyone visiting Barcelona! It is a wonderful way to spend time in the water!

I don’t know where to start! Everything about this experience is just mindblowingly great. Sergio is so nice and delightful, the boat, which is so much bigger in person, was easy to find, and I had the best time. The other guests were also a delight. Easily the best thing I did on my six day trip, and I would have done it again if I had more time.

The trip was realy awesome! We went with a friend from Sergio out, he was a realy nice guy!:)
We did take the sunrise tour! It‘s the best time to make the sailingtrip! You have a great view on the city!:) The water is very clear. The service is perfect, you will get some snacks and champagne!
But if you get sick very fast, you should better stay at the land.
Great experience on this beautiful sailboat, Sergio's friend was at our disposal to make sure we had a better time.

We liked the boat and the captin was very friendly. The swim in the sea was great and worth the trip. All went well except some passengers got sea sick. I recommend that they take pills before starting the trip.

My niece and I had a great time with Chavi as our captain. The boat offered some floats and a paddle board for less proficient swimmers to feel comfortable in the water. Chavi was extremely personable and funny. What a comedian with excellent English! He also recommended a delicious seafood place to eat afterwards. This 2-hr excursions was a nice break from the tourist crowds of Barcelona and summer heat.

Amazing from start to finish! The boat is much bigger than I expected and really well kept. Lovely chilled sail out to see where we stopped to swim in the ocean. Everything was so well prepared- from the floats for the sea so everyone could get in an relax to the constant flow of beer, cava and lovely Spanish snacks. Couldn’t recommend it enough! Thanks for an amazing trip

This is a FABULOUS experience. The boat is wonderful and Sergio and his team are great. You can't beat jumping off of the boat into the waters of the Mediterranean Sea. I recommend it to everyone - it's a great way to spend the afternoon!

I had such an amazing time with Sergio on the boat! He was such a great host, very friendly. He took the time to get to know a little about everyone on the boat. The water was perfect for swimming. The tapas and Cava were a nice touch! I had so much fun I wish it was longer! Definitely the highlight of my trip.
