What an amazing early evening cruise!! The boat was beautiful and the crew was kind and helpful. The water was truly crystal clear and the perfect temperature. While we were swimming, the crew set out some yummy snacks and poured champagne. The whole experience was surreal! If you want a few hours to cool off, see the city from a different perspective, and get away from the crowds, this is the experience for you!!

We booked this experience on a whim and it ended up being one of the best things we did in Barcelona! Sergio was so kind and friendly throughout the entire journey. We swam in gorgeous blue waters of the Mediterranean and he has a bunch of wracks and paddle boards for people to use. After a nice long swim you can lay out on the boat to soak in the sun and are treated to snacks, cava and beer. Wish I could do this everyday!!!!!
These guys were awesome! So much fun I would do it again! I felt like I was on my own private boat! Gracias
Sergio is a really nice person and you can feel his passion about sailing! I really enjoyed the tour and I will definitely come back! A Must do in Barcelona!

We enjoyed wonderful weather in the morning - sunny and no wind, so it was perfect for swimming in the sea.
The water was amazing, not the same feeling as swimming till the beach.
It was around 31 meters depth and Sergio provide the best for us to have amazing experience - some equipment to play in water around the boat, good music, some food and guidence.
Highly recommended!
Great time! Super helpful and one of the best things I did during my time in Barcelona. Such a cool way to see the city!

Really beautiful. A beautiful beginning of the day in the countryside of beautiful people. The perfect place to make new friends and have fun. An experience I would definitely repeat and recommend to everyone.

We enjoyed a beautiful morning!! We did not have any wind, but we motored out on a beautiful sailboat into the blue waters of the Med. It felt to great to be on the water and to swim in the sea (perfect water temp!). There was beer, soda, water, snacks on board. The boat was great and Xavi and his colleague (I cannot remember her name) were great hosts. If you love to be on a boat and love to swim in the sea this is an experience for you!

This was an awesome experience and great way to get out in the sun and ocean in Barcelona! The boat itself was very nice and new and crew was lovely. The size of the group is perfect as it isn’t too big so allows you to get to know each other even in a short time. It was very cool seeing Barcelona from the sea and also a much breezier and more interesting way to spend some time in the sun (the beach is quite hot!). I highly recommend this to anyone, but it’s also perfect if you’re traveling alone as I was. The snacks and drinks were great and the water floats were very fun. The length was also great - long enough to enjoy and not feel rushed but you still can plan other activities for that day. Highly recommend!
If you are hesitating about taking this boat trip, dont hesitate any longer this really was an awesome trip . What a way to finish our trip to Barcelona! Thank you Xavi you were a wonderfull skiper !

This was my favourite experience in Barcelona. My cousin and I went together and, although we can’t swim, we had a very relaxing time just dipping our feet in the water. The host also taught us some basics about sailing. It was altogether an amazing time and I would definitely recommend it to anyone coming to Barcelona.
The sailing with Sergio was very pleasant and exciting. I enjoyed swimming in the beautiful clear water and the snacks were yummy 😊

This was my favorite experience by far! I went solo and ended up meeting really amazing people and grabbing lunch with them another person after. He was an amazing captain and even brought out Cava and a cheese plate. Highly recommend!
Easy choice to make after flight. Kind and generous. Good snacks. Great choice to take in Barcelona from the sea. Might teach you how to set the sail up!
Sergio way wonderful, he was very nice, let any one who wanted help on the sails and stear the boat. We had a wonderful time.

If you are going to visit Barcelona and the weather will allow it, don’t miss the chance for a great boat trip, with spectacular views of Barcelona’s coast, chilling swim in the clear waters of the Mediteranian and the pleasant company of Sergio who will tell you stories of Barcelona and even let you steer the boat.
One of my best experiences ever!
I would recommend it to everyone.
Great time! Carlos & Olga were very welcoming. A wonderful group, fun in the water and of course cava & snacks! Muchos gracias.

Amazing ride with wonderful people! Came alone and left with new friends. A perfect way to meet people, try stand up paddle, swim in the sea and enjoy Cava on deck. Don’t miss out this fantastic break from the city and seeing it from the sea!

A perfect way to cool down outside the shores of Barcelona! We had a fantastic trip enjoying the afternoon sun and the life of sailing. Xavi was a great host, funny and paying attention to everyone in the boat. Highly recommended.
We are a family of five and had two fantastic hours on the boat. Great both for the kids and us adults. Lovely boat and great host. Absolutely recomended.
Ended up deciding to go at the last minute and I 100% recommend. The water / views of the city are beautiful and the hosts are super accommodating.

Xavi was wonderful, we unfortunately couldn't make it to our actual timing because of the Barcelona taxi strike, but he accommodated us by allowing us on the second boat. The food and the cava were amazing, and the floaties he brought were great too! We would definitely do this again :)
The trip has been quite amazing! The guys are very professional, they really know how to sail. We were swimming in cristal clear blue water, listening to great music and having full all along.
Great fun in the sun, lots of toy, paddle boarding, floating toys, whale watching if one would come by?;) had s great time and the food and drinks were right on!

Nice big boat with a very helpful og friendly crew. The swimming was great and the view of the city was beautifull. It was windy on our scheduled time, so the captain offered us a new trip the next morning with better weather conditions. That was a very good idea, and we had a great trip.

It felt more like an afternoon on your friend's sailboat. Sergio was very friendly, allowing people to help bring up the sails & navigate a bit, and made sure we always had a drink in our hands. Getting to swim in the Mediterranean with floaties was really cool too. This was a really fun & unique way to get on the water, see the Barcelona skyline, and learn from a local.
We had a really great time! There were plenty of drinks and snacks, the boat is lovely and the host was very friendly :) you should really do this when you are in Barcelona
Perfect and unforgettable experience! Swimming in crystal clear water, delicious snacks and nice talk with amazing company. We would highly recommend and definitely would repeat this experience!

This was such an excellent end to our trip in Barcelona! Sergio was a great host taking us out to a perfect location to swim, providing drinks/snacks, and instructing us how to set sail. If I ever return to Barcelona in the future, I would definitely do this again!

Sergio was awesome! He was very nice and accommodating, and he offers food and drinks for everyone. I got seasick, so if you're not used to sailing (especially on choppy waters such as the ocean was when I sailed with him) I would recommend taking some motion sickness meds before you go. Otherwise, the view is beautiful, and the experience was amazing. We took some great pictures!
Really liked the yaht trip. It was too short tho - should have booked for atleast 4 hours. :) Sergio was a great host. Thanks!

Awesome time! Sergio was super laid back and a great host. He brought us to a beautiful, calm spot to swim! They provided us with floats, paddle board, drinks, and snacks! He even let us swim a little longer than expected!

Sergio was not there but his Mate Javier was. He was awesome. It was windy so he gave everyone the option to reschedule for another day. He reassured us that current wind conditions were excellent for sailing. Fortunately everyone agreed to continue with the trip. The wind was excellent, made for great pictures. He was very friendly and easy going. One of the girls got sick and he helped her out right away. Very good time and I would book again.
It was such an amazing experience and my family and me absolutely loved it. We really had such a blast and I would recommend this to everyone :)

This experience was really memorable. There was an uncle from Switzerland, a German couple and their mother, and a nurse sister from the United States and a local handsome guy. (it seems to be) the whole process was thoughtfully put on everyone, gave the gentleman a palm, explained some sailing knowledge, chatted, etc. ~ Anyway, everyone is very friendly!The best part is swimming in the ocean! As a person who doesn't know the water very well, I jumped into the sea with my life jacket ~ The sea is very clear and warm, I can say it's great!The German lady also helped me very considerately to make sure I was safe. Finally, there were snacks. Although I was a little dizzy at that time, I couldn't eat... but they all ate very well. Hahaha, it's just that my friends are a little uncomfortable. Everyone is also very considerate. Thank you very much, Captain!Overall, it was a very good experience, very suitable for people who want to experience sea activities, and can make some foreign friends, highly recommended!

Xavi was the perfect guide for us! We had smooth sailing the whole way, he was upbeat and positive and is extremely knowledgeable about sailing. The snacks and cava were excellent. By far the most relaxing day of vacation we’ve had!! The boat was incredible, swimming right off of it was a dream come true! 150% recommend, if you’re in Barcelona you HAVE to spend some time out on the Sea!

Awesome experience! We took our 7yr old with us and they let him drive the boat most of the trip. He was very accommodating even for our little guy.
Thank you so much, we had a great time!

This was the highlight of our trip to Barcelona! Xavi was super helpful when we got lost and also was very informative on the tour! We had a great time swimming in the sea and hanging out on the boat. If you are even considering this, BOOK IT! We want to go back next year and do it again, it was amazing!

A great little getaway. The captain, Xavi, is very kind and thoughtful.
Definitely a highly recommended activity to see Barcelona from another expectation and take a swim in the high seas.
Xavi took the lead today and he was a great host! It was an amazing experience being able to swim out in the clear waters so far away from the shores! Would highly recommend :)

I highly recommend this! Sergio is a fantastic captain/host and the experience is even better than we expected. It took me a little while to get in the water (the record longest, apparently!) and Sergio and the others on the boat were so encouraging and made it really fun. The water really is beautiful to swim in, the inflatables and paddle board made it fun - I’d do it again in an instant. Definitely book this trip!

Sergio was extremely welcoming and informative. The entire trip was so relaxing and was definitely a highlight of our time in Barcelona. He was always willing to take photos and he provided snacks, drinks and floaties, which made our free time in the water all the better. Thanks, Sergio!

Xavi (Sergio’s friend and other captain) was super friendly and knowledgeable about Barcelona. The water was a bit choppy the day we went out, but the water was beautiful and blue and we had fun swimming as well as hanging out on the inflatable swans attached to the back of the boat.

Being on the boat with Sergio was great, you get to see Barcelona from a whole different angle. He provides snacks and drinks which is just what you need while relaxing on the boat! The added bonus of blow up animals in the ocean is a great touch. If you suffer from any motion sickness pop a pill before you go :)
Such a beautiful and fun experience! Nice sailboat and we felt safe with Sergio. Would highly recommend if you’re wanting to get out of the city for a bit and just swim in the ocean or be on a boat!
It was really fun and amazing. Perfect way to spend a day and relax while seeing the whole city from the ocean. Had a fantastic time.
Gracias por todo! The view was great, the water was perfect. Had an amazing time together with my wife! We can’t wait to repeat this experience!
Such a wonderful way to see Barcelona! The boat is super nice and refreshing and a great activity I would suggest to all!

This experience was so much fun! If you want to get away on a boat and relax with fun people this is for you. Xavi met us at Port Olimpic and took us out on the Mediterranean. We had snacks, drinks, and got to take a dip in the nice cool ocean; he even had a paddle board and huge floaties! If you are wondering whether or not to book this, let me say that I would do this every single time I visited Barcelona. It was fun, relaxing, and really made us feel like we were living a lavish lifestyle in Spain! 100% would recommend.
Great experience on the boat, we had beautiful weather and a great group of people from all over the world. Really loved it and would definitely recommended this when you visit Barcelona
The best experience we had In Barcelona. Sergio is an awesome host. He’s very informative, social, and an all around great guy! I recommend everyone to take this voyage!

This was a great experience! I would do it 100000 times again. Sergio was EXTREMELY nice, caring, and accommodating while we were on the boat, and a plus was that he took pictures of us in the water for our IG's : ) I truly had a great time and would recommend this to anyone who asked!

just a pro tip: DO NOT FORGET SUNSCREEN! Sergio warned us of this as well, and it's so true! Be safe and have fun!!
Absolutely amazing experience.... Sergio was great he told us stories about the town and made the time enjoyable.... a must do if you are thinking about it.

Nice boat, and a great way to spend an afternoon to beat the heat and get out on the water. Very comfortable experience and we felt very safe and confident in how we were taken care of as passengers. Highly recommend!

We had a great experience with our 2 kids and another family. Xavi was a fantastic captain and asked often the help of the kids (hoist he mainsail, take the helm of the boat). They loved it! The boat is beautiful and the view of Barcelona from the sea was amazing. The swim in the sea would have been the cherry on the top, but the sea current was too strong. Would definitely recommend this experience!

Such an incredible way to see barcelona! 7 of us in our crew, including including 3 kids and everyone loved the experience. It was a bit rocky for a swim, but perfect wind for a sail. Sergio and his team were pros and excellent hosts. The tapas and cava we’re a delicious treat. We’ll definitely do it again on our next visit to Barcelona.

Lovely relaxing morning on Sergio’s boat, only 4 of us on the trip. We stopped for swimming, snacks and drinks, and Sergio brought a paddle board and inflatables for our stop. He couldn’t have done more to help us and make sure we had a fun trip.

Our highlight of our trip to Barcelona - thank you Sergio :)

This was a wonderful experience and we would definitely recommend booking it! Sergio and his wife welcomed us into their beautiful sailboat and gave us an overview of what we would be doing and where we would be going. We were able to get a view of all of Barcelona! They allowed us to sit on the bow of the boat as we sailed into the Mediterranean. Sergio provided us with beer, water, cava, and local snacks that were delicious! His wife recommended many different places for us to visit and dine. Our favorite part was jumping into the ocean and swimming around the sailboat :) Thank you so much for this experience! It was one of our favorite parts of our trip.

The boat ride experience was exceptional! It’s super easy to find the boat with the directions Sergio provided. I did the boat ride with Sergio’s friend Xavi, and his girlfriend. They were both very friendly and talkative. They provided great insight on Spanish/Catalan culture as well as typical Spanish snacks and cava which were delightful. Once we got out into the ocean, we were able to swim in the water and floating toys were provided. The water was warm, calm, and there were no jelly fish! It was perfect. Overall this is a great experience and I would highly recommend this to anyone traveling in Barcelona

We had an AMAZING time with Sergio! It was very easy to find the boat and Sergio was so kind. He offered drinks and snacks. He even offered to teach a little bit about the boat and let one of us steer a bit! Swimming in he Mediterranean was a dream! Sergio had some floatation devices and a paddle board attached to the boat so we had no fear of floating away from the boat. Even the other air bnb guests were wonderful. It was perfect weather, perfect host, and perfect experience! We recommend this experience to anyone!!!

My mother and I arrived in Barcelona and decided to look for options to explore a little bit of the Mediterranean Sea. We didn't have to spend much time looking because when we saw Sergio's tour, the decision to do it was easy! We're still talking about this fun experience. It made our stay in Barcelona extra special. Sergio was an expert in sailboats and very friendly, wanted to talk to every person in the group and gave us the opportunity to escape the city to experience the beauty of the Sea. My favorite part was when we stopped to swim. Then we tasted a type of cava and Sergio offered us some snacks. It was absolutely amazing and if I could repeat everything, I would definitely do it. Thank you very much Sergio!

My wife and I had a great experience with Xavi on the boat. It was a beautiful day outside, and we were able to sail out into the bay to have a great view of Barcelona and the surrounding area. Xavi provided drinks and light snacks, as well as a couple of floaties and boards to swim with once we made it out to sea. Everything about it was perfect, highly recommended.

We had a wonderful time on the sailboat. Xavi was our host and he was so friendly - great company! We'd definitely recommend this experience, it's a great way to see the Mediterranean Sea and the backdrop of Barcelona. We'd book again if we return to Barcelona. Only one thing, it's absolutely stunning, but it's not "crystal clear" water, it's more of a deep deep blue.

Sergio was the absolute best! You could tell he really loved his boat and what he did and wanted everyone else to enjoy it just as much. He was very knowledgeable and even let us help with the sails. It was a blast! I definitely recommend this tour if you’re in Barcelona. It is definitely one of my favorite memories I made there.

Xavi and Monce (?) were outstanding. They were patient with my 10 year old daughter, showing her how to raise and lower sails and steer the boat. We had an amazing time. Definitely book this experience; you will not be disappointed!

Thank you Xavi!
It was so amazing to experience Barcelona in the sea.
The water was a bit choppy at first & xavi offered to return & refund if we were not comfortable - we wanted to go ahead & I’m glad we did.
Great company, great swim, great food & drinks. A perfect afternoon in Barcelona!

We were sailing with Sergio’s friend Xavi, he was absolutely wonderful! Very friendly and welcoming! Made sure everyone was happy and had a good time! The winds were strong so he made sure to tell us if anyone gets sick he will come back to the land and we’ll reschedule the trip, which was very nice of him! Thankfully everyone was good, we got to swim in the beautiful waters and see the whole city of Barcelona from the sea:)))
LOVE, LOVE, LOVE!!! Highly recommend this to everyone who loves boats and water:)))
Would do it again in a heartbeat!!!
Thank you Xavi:)))

First of all it was an amzing experience....actually it was that great that me and my friend decided to do it twice.... sergio is really nice and friendly although he was very worried about the weather conditions but he just wanted to make sure that we wouldnt be disappointed since we couldnt make a stopp for swimming... his friend xavi was thoughtful and made sure we ware having a great time.... we can totally tecommend this activity and we will definitely come back again!!!

Our tour started with xabi (sergios friend) was very easy to find, he helped us onto the boat showed us where to put our stuff offered us water and beer, we then left the port whilst he told us about some of the buildings and we asked questions he was very informative, we stopped to have a swim which was brilliant! Paddle board and inflatables all attaches with rope so you didn’t float away! We then drank cava and headed back and I was allowed to steer until we got back! 10/10 definitely would do this again!!

A friend and I did the trip with Sergios friend Xavi. We were the only ones on the boat and it was absolutely perfect! Xavi and his girlfriend were the best hosts ever. They were easy to get along with, super attentive and we felt comfortable from the first moment. The tapas were delicious and a highlight were the inflatable swans which we used in the water. Thanks for everything! We‘ll definitely come back!
Its my first Airbnb experience. Everything was amazing and perfectly arranaged. Sergio is very nice, proffessional person. I would really like to try again. Gracias Sergio.

Sergio provided very clear and easy-to-follow directions to the marina and the boat. We found the boat with no trouble and were cordially welcomed by Chavo, our skipper. The boat was clean and well-maintained. Chavo provided intro into sailing for those interested while explaining the skyline of Barcelona. Excellent tour for both experienced sailors as well as first-timers!
It was a great experience and I would definitely recommend. Xavi was a great host, who was filling in for Sergio due to injury. There where plenty of beverages and ample snacks.

We went sailing with Xavi. He’s absolutely magnificent and we had a really great time with him! The hospitality was amazing and will definitely book again next time we’re in Barcelona! Thanks so much for the fun adventure!
I don't know where to start! It was amazing. I really liked the attention, activity and energy of everyone we shared. Highly recommended!!!
Xavi was awesome!! Had a great time and we had a fun bunch on the boat so that made it even better! I highly recommend this boat ride to the fullest its a must if your in Barcelona!

The boating activity was fantastic. So much fun to go out into the sea and to get a chance to swim. Unfortunately, we didn water. (I had to re-book and pay again for the new slot but it was smooth.) Sergio sent us on the boat with his colleague Xavi who was wonderful.
Excellent trip! Sergio was very easy to work with, and Xavi took us out for a wonderful afternoon on the water. I’d highly recommend this trip!

Great experience! Although Sergio did not make the trip with us, he was great in communicating all the details and answer any questions with minutes of submitting. Sergio's friend, Xavi, was an awesome captain. Everything in the details about the experience were met and then sum. Xavi was very accommodating and very experienced. Would definitely recommend this experience for any one interested. Great job!
Xavi was a great captain. There was good company, good snacks and a great swim! He made sure all of us were taken care of. I would do this tour over and over again!

We had an amazing and relaxing time. The Maggie May boat is beautiful and just the right size to keep that proper sailing experience. Our captain was Xavi and he was a lot of fun. He also had loads of information to share with us and could answer any question we asked him. He also let me steer the boat when we used the sails. Food and beverages provided were also brilliant. We'll worth it!!

This was a very fun activity for my family of four. Both my 21-year-old as well as my 12-year-old had a great time on this excursion. Sergio made sure everyone was well hydrated and had a great experience. Whether he was giving people tips on how to sail, letting them have an opportunity to steer or letting them jump in the water with some of the water toys… Everyone had a great time! While we were out on the water he provided some history and perspective of the area. I would recommend this excursion to anyone.
Sergio sent a message before the boat to giving great instructions on how we'd meet at the port. He was a fab host and obviously loved introducing us to sailing!
Very relaxing activity. Friendly captain Xavi made us great time. He showed us how to sail, said something about city and delivered delicious snacks and drinks. Necessary activity!

Don't hesitate to book this experience! We had an incredible time with Xavi. He was incredibly accommodating and the perfect host. Great time, great company, great snacks and fantastic swim! It was the highlight of my 16 year olds entire two week vacation. Winner!!!

Xavi was lovely and accommodating, giving insights into Barcelona. The city looks beautiful from the water! And such blue water it is! The group were great, an amazing way to meet people and experience Barcelona on the water

The boat trip was the highlight of our trip to Barcelona! Sergios friend took us out to sea and we had a lot of time to swim in the beautiful water, food and drinks were provided. We felt very welcome on the boat and it was great that we were such a small group. Would highly recommend it!

This boat trip was simply fantastic. We were taken around Barcelona bay by Xavi, he was extremely welcoming and accommodating! The atmosphere was very relaxed and Xavi was very happy to answer our questions and queries about the areas we were travelling. Unfortunately 2/5 of our party were seasick - we were prewarned before leaving that the waves were particularly large and offered the opportunity to reschedule, we chose not to - and Xavi could not have been more professional and kind with the girls that were unwell. Thank you very much Xavi for this experience, we would all 100% attend again and cannot recommend this activity enough (even those who were unwell!).

My partner and I had a fabulous time on the boat with Xavi. He was very knowledgeable and friendly. The group size of the trip was perfect, small enough to feel intimate but friendly and easy to chat to other guests. There was plenty of beer, soft drinks and snacks for all to recover after swimming in the clear blue sea with the Barcelona skyline. Thanks for a great experience!

Xavi was a great captain and we had a fantastic time. The water and weather were perfect for sailing. Whether you want to relax on the boat or jump into the sea, this is a lovely excursion to get away from the crowded beaches and still be on the water.

We had a great time with Xavi on the boat. We went on the evening boat ride and it was perfect. Water was a little cold, and it got pretty windy on the boat. Best of all, we saw dolphins on the way back.

This experience was amazing! Your (Hidden by Airbnb) story will be poppin during these boat ride. But no amount of pictures or videos will accurately capture the breath taking view of Barcelona from the Mediterranean Sea! The view is simply amazing. We were served snacks and drinks. Got to pop a bottle of champagne with other guests and met some amazing people who we later invited to party with us at night! My favorite part was jumping into the seas and getting on the duck floaty and surfboard provided by the hosts! Sooo much fun I tell you! Would def do this again! And most definitely recommend this to anyone! Also great photo ops for the IG ;)

Sergio was super helpful with the questions I had and the direction to the boat so I was able to enjoy full experience. Plenty of food and drinks (and sunscreens). They can create fun atmosphere and it’s really nice way to meet people. The best part was swimming in the middle of the ocean! I’m not a big fan of swimming in the ocean (love pools) but it did not make me feel nervous at all as the water was calm on our day, plus they have a few floats and a paddle board to hang on. I’d definitely go again! Thank you for making it so memorable!

P.S.
I recommend to plan to get there 15 mins prior to the time so you are not affecting anyone else on the boat. You never know with traffic and other circumstances you wouldn’t expect in the unfamiliar city. They were super nice to people that were late but after 15 mins, we embarked, so we got extra 15 mins on our trip to compensate.

This was our first time using airbnb experiences and we loved it! It was so fun and relaxing to go out on the water and see Barcelona from a different vantage point while getting some sun. Xavi was very accommodating and friendly and did a great job navigating the boat. It was also really cool to be able to meet others visiting the city. Would definitely recommend!

I had the absolute best experience with Xavi! He was professional, kind and extremely accommodating. He really gave us the "wow" experience. I would recommend this short excursion to all visitors who are looking for a personalized but quick (2 hrs or so) sailing trip. Would most definitely do this again! Thanks Xavi!

The boat ride was lovely and Sergio was a great host. He was very knowledgeable about sailing and the city of Barcelona making him a wonderful guide. He was also very amiable, engaging all of his guest and making the ride really fun. He was prepped with sunscreen, towels, water, drinks, and snacks (though I wish there were a few more snacks :). I would definitely recommend this ride!

It was a great experience. The night before the trip, Sergio let us know where and when to meet. The trip was amazing, he offered us some snacks and cold drinks. When we sailed away far enough from the city, we spent sometime to swim in the ocean. When I come back to Barcelona, I'd definitely like to have the same experience with him again. Thank you!

This experience was one of the highlights of my trip. With clear directions, the boat was easy to find and Xavi was there to welcome us. Xavi led our tour and was really friendly and knowledge when we asked various questions throughout our sail. My friend and I met new friends on the boat and enjoyed swimming in the water and listening to music. I would recommend this trip to anyone visiting!
This was one of the highlights of our trip! The weather and water was perfect and the host is super nice. We also met a lot of new friends!
This was the highlight of our trip. The host was really friendly. We also met new friends! It was a good and relaxing experience in and on the water. We really recommend it.

Excellent Sailing Trip! We were fortunate to have amazing weather and also the perfect amount of wind to be under full sail power. Xavi was our skipper and let us take turns sailing, and also provided drinks and snacks. Shout out to awesome people we met on this trip - Winston, Amanda, John, Ivan, and Whitney! - C&L

Had the best time on the sail boat! Enjoyed the experience of trying to sail for the first time, swimming in the ocean as well as the snacks and drinks prepared. Best part was the group that joined! Everyone was similar in age and got along really well. Great way to meet other travellers and head for a night out after

Highly recommend this trip! We sailed with Xavi, who is an excellent, knowledgeable, and laid back guide. Apart from swimming in the Mediterranean with a swan float (what!), we met some amazing new friends from all over the world who were also on this two-hour ride. One of the top highlights of my two-week European vacation, for sure.
It's a lot of fun. Have a try to pitch your sail on your own boat, swim in the Mediterranean, a great experience.

Amazing trip with Xavi. Wonderful experience sailing in Catalunya sea.
Xavi is a great tour guide. Entertaining us with basic knowledge sailing, tapas and drink (drinking water, Estrella beers, diet coke and Cava )
Swimming at the middle of Mediterranean sea is superb.
That is the experience you never forget.
We Loved this experience! Xavi was a great friendly host on the sailboat. When we come back to Barcelona we will do it again!

Highly recommended!!!! It’s fun and enjoyable, captain likes to share with us his sailing knowledge as well as the culture of Barcelona, view is nice.
Beside swimming in the sea, we can do water paddling too! Fun!

Although we didn't get to meet Sergio in person, we absolutely loved our time out on the water with Xavi! We cruised out of Barcelona, out into the water and then were able to take out the floats and the SUP. The only thing I wish is that it was a bit longer - not enough time to just hang out, relax, swim, enjoy the water :)

It was an amazing trip! Everything was taken care of, the boat was super spacious, comfortable and clean. Sergio is a very good skipper and a great host. I enjoyed a lot jumping from the boat into the open sea, it's a really unique experience. If you are in Barcelona right now just don’t loose such an amazing opportunity to enjoy this sea tour with Sergio.

One of the best money investment I did in my holiday. Totally worth it!
Olga is very nice, kind and talkative. I learnt a lot of things about Barcelona and the Spanish daily living. The views are very nice and the overall experience is relaxing.

PS. Olga takes nice pictures, perfect for (Hidden by Airbnb) . :)

Our trip with Sergio was a highlight of our time in Barcelona. Sergio was very clear at the beginning about how the weather was and whether we'd be able to swim and/or sail (we ended up being able to do both), and checking to see what worked best for the group. Definitely book this!

The swim was great - Sergio's boat is the first one on its line of the dock and he was communicative about how to find it. Once we took off, we were provided decent snacks and plenty of beverages (beer and water and soda) and were free to go about the boat and ask questions about Barcelona to our captain. When we got to a good area, we drifted for a bit and were provided a tube and paddle board until we were good to head back in. Overall, really fun experience and a great way to swim in the Mediterranean.

This experience was awesome, the guys were flexible with timing and even offered to take us out on the boat when the sky’s cleared up. They provided snacks, great music and good views. The hosts were courteous and knowledgeable about barcelona we took some recommendations from them to go to an awesome seafood restaurant after the boat ride. You get a pretty good view of Barcelona from the boat, great for pics :)

We had an exceptional host, with a great knowledge of the sea and the Barcelona area as well. Our fellow guests were lovely and made for a very comfortable relaxing time on the open water. Highly recommend to all travellers looking for a bit of sea breeze and sun.
It was a great experience, we could swim in the open sea, there were drinks and snacks. The guide was super nice and attentive :) It was an unforgettable time

Xavi was our skipper for the evening sail. We had an excellent time and all 5 of us agree this is an experience to recommend! We had ages (Phone number hidden by Airbnb) . All communications were quick, clear and responsive. The boat was clean, beautiful, and well-equipped. They even had a paddle board and inner tube for the boys in the water. We enjoyed very much visiting with Xavi, learning some basic sailing techniques, and he allowed anyone to try their hand at helping!! This was an excellent break from city walking and to gaze at the skyline from the sea. Such a great opportunity to meet others and enjoy a special experience in Barcelona!!

This Airbnb experience was super fun and worth the price. Xavi was our captain and was a really friendly guy who made great conversation. There was no one else who signed up for our time slot, so my girlfriends and I basically had a private boat ride.

During the trip out to the deeper waters, it started raining. Xavi offered to take us back and refund us half our money, or gave us the option to stay out there and give us an extra 30 minutes — so nice!! So we took the extra 30 minutes and it stopped raining soon after it started.

The boat offered floaties and a paddle board which was really fun to play on in the deep waters. When it was time to g back to shore, Xavi had set up snacks and cava for us on the boat. We felt like queens! Overall it was a great experience and one of our highlights of Barcelona.

This was the highlight of our trip! The boat is amazing, the crew fantastic!! It was like sharing the trip of a lifetime with old friends. I can not recommend this event enough, beautiful and so much fun!!!!

Unfortunately we did not experience this trip as others had or how it was advertised, we were not provided an opportunity to swim nor use the paddle board as advertised which is the first and foremost reason why we booked this tour. We were not overtly asked if we wanted to swim nor did the boat anchor anywhere, leaving us uncomfortable to ask.

That being said the host was very friendly and engaging.

The airbnb experience was about the same as described so everything beyond that, was fair. Although a few details were not highlighted. This was the first airbnb experience I’ve ever been on, and I went with my sister and mother. I would NOT suggest bringing any kids to this boat, or elderly and handicap people. The guide took us far out to sea for what felt like hours. The entire time, my family and I were grabbing onto something to hold us onto the boat. What you might notice by the pictures is that the railings are absolutely minimal and have no secure feeling to them. They were too short to block any person from falling off the boat if you weren’t careful enough. There was a small seating area, though only sat about 6 people. There were over 10 people when I went. When we went, it felt like high tide waters, so walking *safely* on the boat was extremely difficult. After an hour or so we stopped and waited for anyone who wanted to swim. I thought, maybe we would be closer to a shore, cove or literally anything besides the middle of the ocean to enjoy a dip in the water. Personally, I hate swimming in deep sea so this was not a great option for me. Overall this was a decent experience, but I had higher hopes for this high-rates experience.

Our trip with Xavi (Sergio’s colleague) was great! A very nice boat, great group of people and tasty drinks and snacks! The sun was not as “potent” as you would expect in June, but luckily we cannot control everything in life. All in all a great and worthy experience with an amazing crew!
Sergio was great! It was very laid back and easy going. He answers all the questions you might have about Barcelona and is good at recommending places.
Easy to find boat at port, experienced boat driver, generous with drinks but if hungry would advise to bring snacks, lovely swim would definitely recommend

Sergio is a great host and a sailor!
We had very nice and friendly experience on his sailing boat that lasted around 2 hours, and we wished it was longer. :)
Sergio had enough drinks and snacks on the ride, so we were not hungry, nor thirsty.
When we reached the point where we stopped, Sergio took out a SUP board and a swim ring so we can swim and enjoy in the open sea. On the way back, he introduced us into sailing basics, and allowed us to take the control of the boat, which was awesome experience.
I will do this again next time I visit Barcelona! :)

Xavi was a great host & we had so much fun on this experience! It was our last day in Barcelona & made it great. Swimming in the Mediterranean was wonderful- the water was so clear and refreshing, and Xavi had some floats for those of us who swam. Would highly recommend!!

We loved our trip with Sergio! The sailboat is well appointed, the hosts are friendly and knowledgeable, and even the other guests were sweethearts.

Floating in a giant swan off the back of the boat has been one of my highlights of Barcelona.

We had a fantastic day with Xavi! He provided great conversation, snacks, drinks, and there is a bathroom on board. He also gave everyone the opportunity to learn about sailing and lend a hand. Very laid back, it was a great way to relax in the sun and see the beauty of the sea and the city. In June, the breeze could be chilly but we were able to sunbathe and some passengers chose to swam. Having a light sweater or blanket would have been fine if you're prone to cold. We would definitely recommend, and would do again!

We did not have Sergio, we instead were greeted by his friend Xavi who took excellent care of us, very friendly, brought out a very nice spread of snacks and drinks, and was very informative of sailing and some history of Barcelona. It was a great day out on the water, I would definitely recommend this experience.
Nice experience. Go out into the water and take a dip in the water. Enjoy some beer, coke, water and snacks. If you get sea sick careful, the water was choppy and even I got a little sea sick.

This is a very unique and enjoyable experience and I would highly recommend it to anyone that is interested in sailing/getting out on the water in Barcelona. The staff are incredibly nice and welcoming and make sure you are having the most fun possible. Be forewarned though, the water can be pretty rough so you may get seasick! Overall 10/10 experience
The boat ride was a great day event in Barcelona. The boat was perfect and Sergio was great to work with. Would highly recommend this experience.

We had a very chill afternoon on the water with Xavi. There were 11 of us in the group but he kept us fed and watered and blew up inflatables for us to float around on. He was an attentive but relaxed host. Would recommend if you're looking for an easy way to hang out in the marina.

totally recommend! just a heads up that the water by Barcelona is pretty cold, but you have the option to swim or not to swim depending on how you feel! plenty of snacks and drinks provided, definitely worth the money.
It was a nice boat but there was absolutely no sailing involved - just by motor in and out of the marina and that’s it.
Segio is nice, and the instruction of location is clear. The boat is as good as I imagine. Also, they provide snacks and drinks. It's a very relaxing experience.
I would definitely recommend this experience. Being a Barcelona native Sergio is both nice and very informative. I learned a lot about sailing! Thanks Sergio!

This was a wonderful little afternoon excursion! We had never done an AirBnB experience and were skeptical, but really enjoyed seeing Barcelona from the ocean. It was windy and a little too cold to swim, but perfect sailing weather. We would absolutely do this again next time we're there! Thanks to Sergio and Xani, who was our skipper - we learned a lot about the region and history and got some fun tips for exploring. The snacks and wine were great too!

Great sailing trip with Sergio’s friend!!! He took us around the coast showing us Barcelona from the waters. Great views, great talk, great cava, beer and snacks!!!!!! Had a lot of fun getting out and relaxing ib the waters!!!
What a spectacular experience! We had the boat all to our selves, enjoyed snacks and beer, and got to sail. Would highly recommend to anyone looking for a fun group activity.
The boat trip was a great experience and a nice way to view Barcelona from a different perspective. Sergio was wonderful and i would highly recommend!

We had a blast riding with Sergio! He provided a great experience and was so kind and welcoming. He provided yummy snacks and a variety of drinks to enjoy. Although it was only two hours it felt like much longer. His boat was easy to locate and the whole process was so easy. Truly one of the best ways to take in amazing views of Barcelona.
Xani was a wonderful host, I had a great time. Unfortunately my companion was seasick. I've sailed before but wish I had understood what big water it was, I would not have suggested my companion go.
My family and I had a great experience on Sergio’s boat. Xavi was an awesome sailor and we had great conversation. This was my first Airbnb experience and definitely won’t be my last. Thank you!

What a fantastic time we had sailing! Xavi was very knowledgable of the city and gave us a lot of great info of cool places to see in Barcelona. Even though the water was a bit choppy, we were able to enjoy beautiful weather, and we did find a nice calm spot to hang out for a while. The snacks (cheese, sausage, etc) and beer were also much appreciated. Would love to come back when it's hotter out and actually jump in the water! All in all, I highly recommend!

We couldn't have asked for a better experience! The boat was gorgeous, well kept, and spacious. There was a place to store our belongings in the cabin as well. We had some amazing views of the city, and a lot of fun with the paddleboard and floats in the water! This experience was one of the biggest highlights of our entire vacation and I can't recommend it enough!

We had a wonderful time on Sergio’s boat. His friend Xavi and his lovely girlfriend actually took us out and they were great. I’m 30 weeks pregnant and has no issues at all. They even provided me with some Dramamine at the beginning, just in case. It was a perfect sunny day but even though it was hot, the water was ice cold! The boat was comfortable and there were plenty of drinks and snacks for everyone. I would highly recommend this while in Barcelona. It made for a relaxing afternoon and a chance to get off your tired feet for a couple of hours.

This trip was amazing! My family and I had such an amazing time with Sergio on the boat!
This is a must do!!!

We had a blast sailing with Sergio! He had the boat all ready to go when we got there, provided some drinks, and lots of laughs! We lucked out with our boat-mates, everyone was very nice. Overall a great experience on our last day in Barcelona 😊

Very enjoyable few hours out on the Med. The boat was lovely, the captain nice, and the snacks tasty. The communication could of been better by actually telling us the name of the boat we were looking for at the dock.

It was a great experience! I had too much fun and will for sure want to do this again! Xavi was very kind and helpful and all the other people that went on the experience were just as excited as we were! The water was great and the boat is truly beautiful! Thank you so much!!!

This was one of the highlights of my trip, Xavi was great (Sergio couldn't make it that day). The boat was very nice, he offered us some cava and cañas along with some cured meats and cheese. We got to stop in the middle of the sea and jump out in the sea. We even spotted some dolphins! definitely recommend.
I cannot recommend this enough. Top thing we did in Barcelona! We got great weather, swam in the sea, played on a swan float in the sea, and even paddleboarded. Seriously, do this!

Had lots of fun! I was a solo traveller on this experience and I had fun meeting new people. It was amazing seeing Barcelona from the sea and very relaxing. Great conversation with everyone and Sergio provided beer, snacks and drinks for everyone and some people swam in the ocean and steered the boat. Good Vibes. : )
The ride on Sergio's boat was just what i needed to relax after a trip with so much walking. I met some really cool people and had a great time! If you are considering going just do it!

Booked for 2.5 hours and simply had the best time, Xavier our skipper for the day made is all feel very welcome.

Xavier and his beautiful girlfriend kept us all well supplied with beer and cava and by the end of the trip I think we had made two new friends.

Guys as we said if you ever pop over to london we would love to show you the town.

Much love from me and the boys
This boat trip was awesome. Great way to see Barcelona from the sea and enjoy the nice weather while meeting new people. Our host was very nice and gave us wine and cheese! Thank you for doing this!

A great way to see the whole of Barcelona from the sea. Sergio was interesting and informative. The weather was lovely and the boat was amazing. Had a go at steering and lowering the sails.
Paddle boarding from the boat was fun! Would recommend the trip.
This was a great ride! Even though it was a little windy it was great! Sergio was the perfect host with great beer, snacks and knowledge!

What a way to start my birthday week! Sergio is an amazing person, who gave me, my friends, and my 2 news friends that I met on this ride and unforgettable sail. The experience itself was relaxing and educational due Sergio knowledge of Barcelona.

Didn't have the chance to get in the water due to weather 😢, but that's okay. I know where to go when I come back to Barcelona.

Oh and as a plus, you get to learn how to steer a boat 😁! One of the greatest highlights of my life!

Sergio was really great and super patient when we had some trouble finding the place. The food and drinks provided were delicious, and Sergio and his wife were very inviting and friendly. The boat was a little rockier than we expected so we got a little seasick, but if it hadn’t been for that I’m sure it would’ve been great! Even so, Sergio and his wife gave us blankets and motion sickness medicine to help us feel better.
We had an amazing time on Sergio’s boat. It was windy but we still went out and had a fun experience. It was nice to see Barcelona from a different angle. I would definitely recommend it :)

Although I didn’t had the chance to meet Sergio, he was so helpful. He did everything he can to make sure everything was right. It was a great tour! I met new people from all around the world! There were a lot of waves and the water was freezing, these transformed the trip to a story that I would share. Amazing people, amazing crew, organized event, unique experience. I fully recommend.

We loved our time on Sergio’s boat! Unfortunately, Sergio could not make our time but his friend Xavi took us out instead. Xavi was super knowledgeable about sailing, and insured we had a great experience. His friend who joined him even offered to take our picture on her nice camera! This sailing trip is a experience we will never forget.

Amazing few hours on the water!!! A must do on your Barcelona trip! We had a blast sipping champagne relaxing on a beautiful day. The boat is beautiful and Sergio is the BEST host! So nice and was super quick to respond to any of my questions.
Sergio is awesome! I had a good time talking to him about Barcelona, the history of the city and his experience living there. It was a good introduction to a beautiful city.

Really fun experience. We had some trouble the boat, but we just called Sergio and he was able to direct us. The only thing that was a downside, is that we didn’t really “sail”. We more just power boated around Barcelona.
The weather was cold and raining that day. Lucky for us the group that we were with on the boat made it a fun outing

Had a great experience with Xavi. He provided plenty of beer, Cava, and snacks along the way. The 2 hours went by super quick, would have been nice if experience was 3 hours instead of 2. Overall we had a great time and would recommend this experience!

Sergio was an awesome host. Definitely the BEST experience we had in Barcelona. He allowed us to to drive the sail boat and was able to learn a few things on sailing. We jumped into the ocean and did some paddle boarding as well. Sergio is very knowledgeable in the sea and a very friendly host. A must when in Barcelona. Get ready to hoist the sail!

I highly recommend. Sergio and his wife were wonderful, and it was such a great experience. There was a group of 7 of us, and Sergio offered snacks, cava, water and coca cola. It was a little chilly when we went in April, but it was still wonderful. It was such a unique, relaxing experience and a welcome change from being in the busy city.

Great ride on the sailboat! Food and drink was provided and Sergio was a great host. Could sit anywhere on the boat and was able to jump in the water and swim and sit with our feet in the water. Very fun and a great experience!

The boat trip was lovely, we and the other 5 members had a great time and Sergio was informative and interesting. He encouraged us all to go swimming in the freezing water but we all enjoyed ourselves. Sergio told us many interesting things about Barcelona, the surrounding towns and the boat, as well as providing drinks and snacks. We can’t think of anything that would improve this trip
Sergio is a simple and attentive guy who does not hesitate to take care of you and explain a class on how to navigate. Without a doubt, a pleasant and responsible guy to share pleasant moments with

Love this sail, Sergio was super awesome. The water was a bit cold but once you jump in your body gets used it. I was looking for dolphins but didn’t get to see any dolphins in my sail. Sergio provided us with beers, sodas, chips and champagne. Don’t be scared of getting sea sick as Sergio will.
Our trip with Sergio was a wonderful experience. We enjoyed the sun and the Mediterranean in the most special way. A highly recommended experience
This excursion was a wonderful way to enjoy the beautiful water. Sergio was a very attentive host and made sure that we had a great time. I would definitely book with Sergio again!

The experience with Sergio was great. Although we had a bad day, we enjoyed it a lot and it was very enriching since Sergio is a very smart guy and a person you can learn a lot from. I recommend it 100%.
There were 4 of us (+ Sergio) on his 14-meter sailboat. The walk was lovely and Sergio taught us a lot about sailing. I highly recommend this experience!
Sergio was super friendly. He was also very informative, and you could ask him everything about sailing. Overall we had a really great and amazing experience on a beautiful sailing boat!

Sergio is a great host, he provide us safety on boat, food and beer, this is what i called once in a lifetime experience. I highly recommend you to try this experience ;) see you when i see you sergio!

We had a fantastic spring sailing on Sergios magnificent Jeanneau that is in excellent condition. Sergio is very professional and speaks good English. Everything was in perfect order on the boat. I really liked that we got to be active and take part of the actual sailing . This is an experience you can not miss out if you are in Barcelona.
I will be back for an extend cruise.

Thanks a bunch Sergio!

/Anton and Tom

Amazing trip! Sergio was so sweet and his boat is awesome. We honestly booked this last minute and we were so happy how accommodating he is and what a great experience! After it is great to walk around the beach area and enjoy, there are plenty of restaurants and things to do around the port. Well worth it !

Sergio is such a great host! This sailing experience was a lot of fun! We did not visit any coves or swim in the water like depicted in the photos, but we went in March and the weather was a bit too chilly for that. We did have a nice cruise and it was great to see Barcelona from the water. The snacks are very light so make sure to eat before you come on board.

We had a great morning with your experience. Sergio is very nice and we loved chatting with him for the two hours. Our dog Kubo has also been able to enjoy the trip on Sergio's sailboat and receive his attention. 100% recommended experience!!!
Perfect, Sergio is a very attentive person, speaking very well English, the trip was very pleasant and we recommend it to all.

It was a very good experience and Sergio was friendly and trustworthy. Spent more than 2 hours by the sea in Barcelona.👍If it's a bit of a roadmap, remember to go out early to find the port, otherwise it's shame that the boat is waiting😂

This was an amazing experience! Not only do you get to sail the waters but learn a little about sailing and Barcelona by sea. We even got to see some dolphins and Sergio was extremely knowledgeable about the boat. He gives you blankets in case you get cold and some snacks to munch on. You get to know the people on the boat and it makes for amazinf photography. Thank you for the experience!

this experience was amazing! We went with our kids (5 and 7 years old) and they enjoyed a lot. Sergio is very frindly and make us feel safe all the time even if it was quite windy :)...we also met a family of delphins!!!

Sergio is a friendly captain and host of this beautiful experience
We had snacks and beverages but since it is cool none of the four guests wished to swim
Sergio cruised further and we got to see a spectacular sunset over Barcelona thank you Sergio

Sergio is a great host! I had a taxi mix up and he waited nearly 10 minutes for me to get to the meeting place. Myself and a couple others were unfortunately prone to sea sickness and he did everything possible to accommodate us. Definitely a fun way to spend some time in Barcelona! Even better if you do it during the summer months!

Thank you Sergio!

Sergio offered a truly unique experience. The boat itself was beautiful. He was skilled enough to accommodate even someone like myself who is prone to serious sea-sickness and in so doing carefully planned the course to assist with that. Learning more about sailing, getting a chance to sail, and of course swim in the beautiful waters was worth every penny. Fully recommend this experience. It is an appreciated break from audio guided tours and pounding the stone streets.

Our experience was fantastic. Sergio was a great host and captain. My girlfriend gets very seasick normally but he was very careful to help prevent that by stopping the boat in a perfect spot for her to jump in for a swim to help clear her head. By the end of the trip she way at the helm having a great time! He was knowledgeable and easygoing, giving us a little history lesson of the coastline as we cruised. I would definitely recommend this experience for anyone looking for a light day sail.

What a fantastic morning! The sailboat was beautiful, Sergio was a great host who was engaging, friendly and gave us a great introduction to Barcelona and the neighbouring cities as we sailed along the coast. We got a chance to swim in the ocean, steer the boat, and Sergio was ready with snacks, drinks and towels. 2 hours flew by so quickly and we couldn't recommend this enough!

The sailing adventure was an amazing addition to our Barcelona/Spain trip! Sergio was exceptionally knowledgeable and had lots of great recommendations for places to visit. It was wonderful seeing Barcelona from the water. I highly recommend this AirBnB experience!
I gave this trip as a gift to my parents, and they loved it! Everything was so perfect. Thnx a million, i really mean it!
The weather got cold and the sea breeze was so full;; but it was nice to have a blanket! It would be better if you go in the summer!!

Sergio and his wife were incredibly great hosts! They let us have a unique experience and be free to eat and drink as much as we wanted! The views were marvellous. They were always smiling making sure we got everything we needed! Strongly recommend it. JUST GO FOR IT!!! plus we also made new friends haha

Very nice trip! I enjoyed the view and it was very relaxing. Great communication with Sergio and his wife very kind! They give us a champagne bottle and snacks with a great view of barcelona!

Thank you sergio!
it was very nice!! we totally enjoyed the view and even swimming!! This is one of my best moments in barcrlona. Higly recommned this!

Sergio has nice, big and clean boat, which has enough space for you to change and keep all the extra stuff. The sailing experience itself is very good but the highlight is jumping off the boat into the sea, it is a must try. Sergio and his friend both are very nice and friendly people.

Sergio was a great host. The boat was amazing, and the waters were clear. We even went swimming a bit. It was slightly chilly in the water, but you get use to it very quickly. I would definitely recommend this trip.

We went sailing with Sergio and his wife and they were both so friendly. The boat is amazing(!!!) and the whole experience is super nice! It feels like a trip with friends with the best view! Thank you so much!

This experience was awesome! Not a best way to sail the mediterranean than with Sergio. Nice, relax experience. Picture it, cava, nice people, great conversations, new friends, a chance to learn a bit from Sergio and his wife... pretty cool Sunday morning I had.
Sergio was awesome! Very nice guy and we had a wonderful time sailing . Even got to help with the bails and sail. 👌 highly recommend this tour. Thank you Sergio.
Sergio was unable to make it but made arrangements to have Xavi take over. Xavi showed us a great time sailing and would highly recommend this experience.

Sailing with Sergio was one of the highlights of our trip to Barcelona! I can’t stress enough how great the experience is and also how wonderful of a host Sergio is. Don’t miss out on this one! And make sure you get in the water- It’s a little cold but so worth it!
Nice apartment!!! Almost in the historical center of the city! Very spacious and cozy. I would like it to be cleaned)

Sailing with Sergio made our day) In several minutes it becomes clear, that it’s just the right thing to do in this city. The whole idea to watch the coast from the water, to rock on the waves a little bit, and, may be, to swim at a depth of 50 meters, is great, and with Sergio we made the best of it: he was very nice and attentive to us, accommodative and, he’s a really interesting person. Would advise him to everybody, thanx twice again!)

Everything as advertised. A lovely afternoon sailing along the Catalan coast. How often do you get to do that in life? Sergio is extremely knowledgeable about the area, the drinks and snacks are great, and a swim off a sailboat in the sparkling Mediterranean is a one-of-a-kind experience.

Sergio was an amazing host! I hadn't booked an experience on Airbnb before so I was a little hesitant but there was no reason at all to be. Sergio was very welcoming and made us feel right at home on his boat! He had some yummy snacks along with water, soda, beer, and cava at the end! We got to swim out in the ocean which was an amazing experience! He even taught and allowed my husband and another girl to steer the boat which was a special touch. He told us all about Barcelona and his adventures. I highly recommend this experience! Well worth it!

This was a great little excursion with a local guide. The boat was very comfortable, very easy to find in the marina. We swam, had some cava, and learned a little bit more about the city of Barcelona from Sergio. He was a very accommodating host. I would recommend this experience!

This was one of the best experience s ever! Sergio is amazing, his boat is beautiful, the waters are really crystal clear and the sail is something you shouldn't miss! We met very cool guys, Sergio got us some traditional tapas and cava and told us a lot of things about Barcelona and the sailing. We swam in the Mediterranean and the water was unexpectedly warm for the middle of October. I highly recommend this experience!

Sergio meet us at the dock right on the hour and we hopped on the boat and he quickly had us leaving dock and out to sea right away. You can tell immediately that he is a master captain & sailor.
We booked with a group of 6 and bought some of our own wine and food but Sergio shared a bottle of Cava and also provided some delicious cheese, chips and pickles.
It was a sunny day and before we knew it we were jumping off the bottle and swimming in the Mediterranean. It was like out of a dream. Sergio mirrored out energy and was playing music and happily answering all our questions about the Barcelona skyline, Catalonia life and his sailing expeditions. The 2 hours flew by as we zig zagged out on the sea and before we knew it we were back at the dock right on time to make it to our next Barcelona adventure. This was the highlight our of trip and I will definitely be booking again if I return. Don't miss out on the unique experience!

Absolutely amazing. Sergio is a very nice guy with great experience about not only sailing but also how to get yourself engaging to the activity，then you feel totally relax， safe and enjoying all around the trip. I learned how to control the boat (of coz only very basic steps I took) and that’s my favorite part. The girls are enjoying swimming so much in Mediterranean. In a word, highly recommended! And Sergio I will be back to Barcelona and sailing with you next summer! LOVE Spain!

It's definitely a very good experience. We started from the dock，the weather was good. Sergio rided us out on the ocean but we can still see the city. We jumped into the water，it was crystal clear and clean. We had music and photos. Sergio taught us how to ride the sail back to the port，great day！
Absolutely amazing way to spend a couple of hours. Sergio is a great guy and was very accommodating. I would do this again and recommend this to anyone!

Wonderful experience with Sergio. He is a great guy, good conversation, learned some about the boats and Barcelona, even got to steer the boat! Ocean is still ok temp for swimming, water is clear and beautiful. 6 people with us, very chill vibe. Not too small of a boat, very nice and comfortable. As interactive as you want it to be. Overall excellent experience, will be back to say hi next time we are in Catalonia!

My boyfriend and I had a great time on the water with Sergio! After having seeing Barcelona from land for a few days, it was amazing to be able to see it from the water! It was great sailing weather and swimming in the Mediterranean Sea was unforgettable! Definitely a great morning adventure during our few days in the city.

The service is really good!
After sailing a little bit we decided to swim in the water which was really fresh^^
It was a perfect mix of chilling, talking with other and seeing Barcelona from the water.
A guy told us some interesting facts and there was a little feel good music in the background.
Very well done!
It was a very nice trip with relaxed people. And they know how to sail! Bonus was the swimming. Even in october water is still nice:) Take this tri If you want to destress from the big city!
The hosts are attentive and the yacht is of good quality even though the food and drinks offered in the description are not real, only a beer and a piece of cheese with olive oil were offered.

The sailboat ist just super, even if it the weather was windy it was a great trip and we swam too. Sergio explain us something about sailing and also when to be careful because weaves coming... It was a great new experience for me and I can only recommend it...

Great boat ride! Sergio was very knowledgeable and accommodating and took great care of our group. It was a lovely way to spend a couple of hours in Barcelona and I would highly recommend this experience to friends.
Sergio was very nice and talkative! It was one of my best trips in Barcelona. Highly recommend to join in this trip for everyone. I enjoyed a lot;)

We were very fortunate to book our sailing on the best weather day of our vacation! Olga and Xavi were perfect hosts! We all took the plunge into the beautiful Mediterranean (a bit cold for some! It's October!), swam for a bit, them enjoyed snacks and beverages. It was just a lovely day!

I give him five stars even though we did not end up going on the sailing trip. The reason for this is because he’s a very honest person and isn’t just looking for your money by hoping you fully enjoy your time. Sergio reached out to us the morning of our sailing trip to inform us that the waves were choppy and that we wouldn’t be able to stop and it would be a bumpy ride. He said if we did not want to go die to the weather, that he would contact Airbnb for us and give us a refund. We decided not to go since we have a friend who doesn’t do well with chpppy water. Sergio handled it all for us and I got the email from Airbnb stating my refund was on its way. When I come back to Barcelona I’ll definitely book with him again and hopefully be able to go this time. Great host and you can tell he really cares.

Sergio is a very enthusiastic reliable man who also communicates very well. The sailing trip due to the price should have been a little longer from me, but I really enjoyed it!
Definitely recommend👍

We had an amazing time on Sergio's sailboat! The weather was perfect as were the drinks and snacks provided! We enjoyed swimming in the beautiful Mediterranean. Definitely a highlight to our trip. Would highly recommend!
Sergio was a magnificent host. He was very patient, hospitable and flexible. I would definitely recommend him to anyone who's looking to have a relaxing time on the Mediterranean.
AMAZING DAY!!!! Beautiful boat and Sergio was extremely kind. We got to paddle board and swim in the beautiful water. Would definitely recommend this experience!

Beautiful boat, great day out on the Mediterranean sea. No better way to down an afternoon in Barcelona than on the water with Sergio as the captain. We got caught in a difficult transportation situation with strikes in Barcelona on the day of our excursion, but Sergio was able to reschedule our trip and was very accommodating. Amazing sailing!

Sailing and swimming in Mediterranean is a dream, now it comes true (almost...)! I got a cold before the trip, so couldn't swim this time. But you won't feel boring at all, chat with Sergio, sunshine bath, drive the boat, delicious cheese, perfect afternoon!
Sergio was a lovely guide, and jumping in the cool water was a memorable highlight of our trip to Barcelona! Thank you Sergio!

Definitely one of the best experiences of the trip (even of my life so far I would say), it was such a beautiful and relaxing experience that I can barely explain in words. And Sergio treated us great, he's super friendly and attentive to everything we wanted or needed.
I recommend to anyone considering this idea and you won't regret it.

Absolutely incredible trip, highlight of my stay in Barcelona. Sergio was the perfect host, helpful and friendly. We had the most relaxing time on his boat and he made my birthday extra special. Thank you!

Sergio was unable to sail the day we went, but his wife Olga was exceptional! My girlfriend and I were accompanied by 3 other couples who all were a joy to be around. Olga provided beverages and a great, fun atmosphere. Definitely recommend!
Has a blast. Boat was great, water was beautiful, and it was a fun time meeting other people and enjoying the water out there.
A great experience! A fun ride at sea, and the hosts were accommodating and made sure everyone had a good time and were comfortable. Highly recommended!
Loved it! Olga and Xavi were perfect hosts. Highly recommend - great day sailing, talking with other guests, enjoying snacks/cava, and jumping into the sea! Don't miss this experience!
We had a very nice afternoon with Olga. We enjoyed the sun and a good beer. We got some snacks and had good conversations with Olga and the other participants. I would do the tour again :)

Our time on the boat was very relaxing. It was a very nice way to spend the afternoon, and Xavi and Olga made us feel very welcome and comfortable. I would have loved to learn a bit about sailing as well, as it was my first time on a sail boat. Great views of Barcelona!!

We had a great day sailing! Finding the yacht was really easy and Sergio was great at communicating everything. We met some lovely other guests who shared the experience with us, there were 10 on board in total. We enjoyed swimming in the open water and there was plenty to eat and drink. We would highly recommend this experience!

Thank you Olga and Xavi! We had a wonderful sunny afternoon on a nice boat, met some great people and super fun time swimming (wow!!), great snacks and drinks. Cava + boating and swimming in the sea = perfect afternoon for me!

It was great! So much fun - beautiful water, kind host ( captain Sergio!) and stunning views. We had an awesome time, had snacks and Catalan sparkling wine. Definitely recommend to everyone who loves water and sailing.

Our experience with Sergio was nothing short of amazing. The afternoon was spent with great company (just the right amount of people on a boat for a social and intimate experience). Sergio's hospitality was so genuine. He's funny too!

The boat was easy to find, it's moored right on corner, just down a flight of stairs. Sergio was a gracious host, chatted with everyone, provided exactly what he described and I would definitely recommend this trip to folks. Folks in our group did take a swim, I didn't however I had memorable experience with some fun, easy going folks.

Everything was just amazing - the sea, the yacht and great company! I think this is one of the best things you should do in Barcelona! Sergio is very friendly and attentive, with a great sense of humor! It was fun and fun! Gracias, Sergio!
We had an amazing time with Sergio, a seasoned sailor and tour guide. The boat was lovely, the trip was great, snacks and beverages provided. Well equipped for every eventuality! Highly recommended.

Sergio was an excellent captain and guide. His boat is very clean and comfortable. We had a lovely time getting out on the water with him. Would recommend this excursion to anyone wanting to get out on the sea while in Barcelona.

Sergio was a great host and gave each of his guests one on one time to discuss and get to know us which made the excursion fun and relaxing. The boat location was easy to find and I recommend this experience for anyone visiting Barcelona, especially when the weather is agreeable. Thank you Sergio!!
The experience is well worth it, Sergio has been very kind, we have felt very comfortable and enjoyed the views throughout the trip on a very large and well-kept boat.

The ride was really fun. You get to meet new people and Sergio was very welcoming. It's the end of September, but we were still able to jump in for a swim. Make sure to bring your own towel though. Sergio gave us all a bottle of wine to share and snacks. His boat should be very easy to find.

We had a great time The weather was a bit cloudy but the water was beautiful. We had a full load of people that were all talkative and funny. Sergio did a wonderful job of making us all welcome He explained things about how sailboats operate ropes, sails,wind etc very informative We all had a wonderful experience Rose. J from Minnesota

Sergio was a very personable host. He seemed to enjoy taking us out. The swimming part was a bit disappointing in that we did not go a cove to swim but rather just out in the sea. In all I thought it was a bit pricey for what we got. I really enjoyed the sailing, however. It was quite a nice boat.

Sergio was a fantastic host and captain! He really made the sailing experience fun and very relaxing. He was patient and accommodating as some guests arrived later than expected. He constantly reassured our diverse group of passengers onboard that everything was going to be ok if anyone was feeling uneasy or inexperienced. Sergio was knowledgeable, outgoing, and had a great sense of humor. It was nice listening to music while he provided us with beverages, wine, chips, cheese, salami, and crackers. He allowed us to be hands-on with the sailing experience, encouraging us to assist by letting go of certain ropes and steer the wheel. He also encouraged us to explore several parts of the boat and help us take pictures. My friend and I really enjoyed our first time sailing in Barcelona. We had an unforgettable time meeting new friends and jumping in the water. Thanks Sergio!

A beautiful and scenic experience. Sergio is so charismatic and knows what he is doing. He was very knowledgeable and overall I would do it again! We went out and had an opportunity to jump into the water. He also treated us to some snacks and wine.

Really crystal deep blue water,And we swim in the Mediterranean thought it's a bit cold in this season. Captain Sergio is a hospital hostess, try to make every partner have an unforgettable experience. I love this trip. One importan tip: take care of your phone,or it will swim in the sea!

We had a great time sailing with Sergio! We enjoyed sailing in the sun, getting to know new friends while sipping on Spanish wine, and taking a dip in the sea. Would definitely recommend this experience!

We went out on a day that was a little rough on seas (yes, we received our fair warning from Sergio!!!) and weren't able to go paddle boarding and swimming. But Sergio's team took good care of us and we had an amazing time! Thank you for the memories on the Mediterranean!
This was a fantastic day trip in Barcelona - very relaxing and Sergio is so knowledgeable about the city. I highly recommend this trip on his beautiful boat, Maggie May.

This was still a great event even though the weather wasn't that great that day. We still sailed and had a great time. Sergio was communicative to ensure the weather was cooperating enough for sailing. He was also great at hosting and made sure everyone feel comfortable on the boat.
We enjoyed being in the sailboat for the afternoon. It was nice to take a break from the streets for a bit. Sergio was very nice and welcoming.

It was everything described. Sergio is very polite and takes care of his guests. The swimming is great and the ride is very scenic. It's always fun to met new people too. So glad I did this! I absolutely recommend!

Sergio was an awesome guide! His boat was clean and well-kept. He gave us a great history of some of the buildings we could see and of the entire city of Barcelona. After swimming in the sea for a little he provided us with some cava and snacks. This was one of the highlights of our trip and we would recommend this to anyone traveling to Barcelona!

Amazing adventure on the Mediterranean! I booked this experience after another one I booked was cancelled due to the weather the day before. Sergio's communication was superb, and he was very nice. He makes you feel very comfortable on the boat.

Me and 7 girlfriends went on this excursion and had so much fun! This was my first time on a sailboat. It can get a bit windy and some girls did get nauseous, but the rest of us had a blast! Sergio was very polite and fed us some light snacks and cava. We made a stop in the middle of the Mediterranean and all of us jumped into the warm waters. Lots of memories were made, thank you Sergio!
Sergio is an excellent host. His boat was clean, well cared for & stocked with plenty of snacks, drinks, towels, etc. Sergio was very friendly & was also a very knowledgeable tour guide.
Sergio was great! Super knowledgeable and truly cared about everyone's experience. The boat was beautiful and comfortable. The waves were a little rough that day, but a wonderful time was had by all.
