It was a great experience. Very well coordinated and sergio made every feel very comfortable. It started at perfect time and wasn't too long to take up entire day that was perfect. Sergio knows the waterways well and is a great sailor. Fun little boat activity with some snacks and drinks made up for a fun experience. Highly recommended!
This was a great trip for a couple of hours to see the coast of Barcelona and meet some interesting people. Sergio was gracious as the captain of the boat and tour guide.

Our sail with Sergio was a fantastic experience. His boat is beautiful and he is so kind and welcoming. We were able to swim in the sea which was so warm and beautiful and then enjoy snacks and wine provided by Sergio. I highly recommend this trip to anyone visiting Barcelona.

Had an amazing time on this experience! Sergio was super nice and looked after us all very well. He gave even gave us lovely drinks and snacks! The swimming was definitely my favourite part - the deep blue sea was clear, warm and so refreshing in the hot Barcelona weather. I highly recommend this experience, it's a must do! Thank you Sergio hope to see you again next time in BCN! :-)

The kind and smiling captain knows where a very good sea. And he's ready to show it!) Everything was friendly, fun, and that is important - reliably. And of course the people who were on board made our tour very pleasant)
The host is so kind to tell us the water condition is not good on that day, and enables us to cancel the event and give us a refund. Appreciate his professionalism and honesty.

I am so glad that I did this in Barcelona, it was such an aging experience. My first time in a boat and not just me but we were all treated with such respect and kindness it was lovely. Sadly Sergio couldn't make it so he sent his mate and his wife in his place, they were both so warm and welcoming, would definitely recommend to anyone staying in Barcelona for a couple of days!

We loved our getaway and it was a real pleasure to meet the passengers who came from many countries. Really recommended because swimming in the middle of the sea, seeing Barcelona from a sailboat , it's just magical. Thank you so much!!

unfortunately the trip was boring. sergio has not done anything to make it a special sailing tour for us. all in all he was not really talkative. it seemed like he was not really happy with having guests on his boat. only a few drinks were served and we had to ask to turn the music up. however, we have been happy being on a boat when the attack happened.

We had a great time sailing around with Sergio. He was a very kind and thoughtful host. His description of the experience is quite spot on - we drove out to a peaceful area off Barcelona's cost and were then able to float and swim in the clear waters around the boat. After finishing our swim, he provided snacks, beer, and a bottle of Cava for our happy group. Would highly recommend!

This is a great experience even for those who are doing this alone, you meet some great people from all around.

The experience itself was also great, you get to swim, float, and paddle board, while you enjoy some drinks and great company.

Sergio was an awesome host and we very much enjoyed our trip! We felt relaxed and Sergio was just awesome! He was very friendly and knowledgeable about the area. We didn't feel like just another tourist, but we truly felt as if we were friends! Sergio had many great recommendations for sightseeing and the cava he had onboard for us to try was so awesome that we bought a few bottles to bring home with us!!! HIGHLY RECOMMEND THIS EXPERIENCE!!!
One of my favorite parts of my trip to Barcelona. We swam, saw dolphins, and enjoyed drinks and snacks. So glad I did this. Sergio was kind and knowledgeable.
The experience was good! It was kind of windy that day so waters was rough, but we had a good swim. Saw dolphins along the way; even chase after them.

It was just amazing. Sergio is a great host who was happy to show us and inform us about barcelona and the basics of sailing. The snacks and the drinks were on point and the pink flamingo floaties are cherry on top! :) love it!

Sergio was super friendly and helpfull! He made us feel at ease.
The boat was clean, but a little small for 10 people.
We had drinks and snacks and a lovely swimm in the sea!
If you love sailing, and your stomach is prepared for the sea then we would really recommand it!

We LOVED our experience with Sergio! He was very friendly and extremely helpful leading up to the trip! This was one of the highlights of our stay in Barcelona! The sailing was so fun and relaxing! We loved swimming and paddle boarding in the Mediterranean. We even saw a large school of dolphins. We loved the small group and it was fun meeting new people from other parts of the world. Truly exceptional experience and I would highly recommend Sergio!

This whole experience was amazing from beginning to end. Sergio was so nice and provided us with drinks and snacks. It was a really fun way to experience Barcelona from a different point of view. Would definitely recommend if you want to get out of the city for a few hours and do something fun!
This was a great way to see a different view of Barcelona! Sergio was so nice and accommodating. My friends and I had so much fun!

A group of 5 and myself had a perfect sunny day on Sergio's boat! Sergio is extremely kind and passionate person that made everyone feel comfortable om this sailing experience. Overall the waters are calm, but my friends and I were nervous about getting seasick. I would recommend taking medicine for motion sickness if you have any concerns which worked for us! Highly recommend to groups visiting Barcelona.
It was an amazing experience, Sergio is a great guy and an awesome skipper and I will certainly do it again next time I'm in BCN! Thanks, Sergio!

We had a fantastic time on the boot.
Sergio had always a smile on his face and he pointed out interesting facts about Barcelona.

This was a highlight of our trip to Barcelona. Sailing out from the busy shore to swim in the WARM blue sea, dive off the boat, paddle board and view the city from a different perspective was just wonderful and such a change from the crazy busy Barcelona Beach. We met a friendly and fun group of people who made the trip even more enjoyable.
Sergio was very friendly, professional and helpful in organising an alternative time to sail when the weather reports were unfavourable for our booking time. On a practical note, there is below deck space where you can get changed if needed and don't hesitate to take your camera.

Sergio was awesome, funny cheerful and answered all our questions!We felt super safe even when winds got heavy.The boat is great for a tour with friends if you want to have a private event! And he was especially caring when some of the group got sea sick!
We will for sure visit sergio again🤗

Sergio's boating experience was top notch! We actually got a chance to sail and swim on the open sea. Great host that was very friendly and good at communicating with you us about the weather. Highly recommended!

Sergio is absolutely amazing!!! The experience was one of a kind. My husband and I couldn't be more happier with the service he provided. He's very knowledgable, great, and made sure everyone felt comfortable. I got a little sea sick on the way back and Sergio made sure I was ok. I would definitely recommend doing this! Not only do you gain a great experience but you get to mingle and meet with other travelers. My husband and I would definitely do this again when we travel back to Barcelona / with a motion sickness pill by my side! Lol Thank you Sergio!

Sergio, our boat captain is very knowledgeable and safe when it comes to planning the excursion. He has a first Class understanding of the tides, winds, and weather accompanied by a global database subscription service that shows changing weather conditions, the same service used by cruise ship captains. Besides being so prepared, he is a fun guy and knows how take care of his passengers!! Today was my last day on vacation in Barcelona and was by far the most fun day. We found a gentle spot in the Mediterranean and jumped in the water which was warm like a bathtub, no joke! We had plenty of delicious snacks and chance to visit with the other guests. I highly recommend Sergio who owns the boat and wanted us to enjoy the exceptional coastal views and water.

The seas were very choppy and a few of us got sick which was a bummer, but overall was a cool little experience to swim and see the city from the water. And it didn't last too long, allowing us to still have time for other activities
I loved this experience. Sergio was very accommodating and really felt the needs of the guests. We swam and had a wonderful snack afterwards! Recommend to everyone!

It was awesome. Sergio was really nice and everything was well explained. the view of the whole city was exceptional and the sea was really beautiful and blue where we went swimming. I would recommend this experience to everyone

Sergio is very nice. We had so much fun. While having a cool drink we sailed on the coastside. We also had the chance to jump into the blue sea which was such an amazing experience! On the way back we had some snacks and a very nice chat. I would book Sergio's tour any time again:)

We Love Barcelona in all ist urban Beauty, But on a hot summer day there is nothing better than to leave the city by boat, leave the heat and be out on the open sea. Sergio's boot is as in the picture, he is friendly and speaks English. Just being out in the sun, enjoying the waves and jumping off the boat into the water was pure joy. Barcelonas view from the sea while swimming or giving the paddle board a spin from his boat. Cheers Sergio, you refreshed us!

Been to Thailand tried similar experience, a little disappointed with this one. Not enough time, no life jacket(big waves, can't really swim in the sea). But defo better than going to the beach & good for taking pics...

Amazing experience! Def a must do when you're here in Barcelona. Get ready to enjoy a relaxing few hours at sea. Sergio was exceptional. Constantly asking if everyone was ok and reassuring that we would have a good time. The view, the wind, the sun! All you can ever ask for! Thanks again Sergio.

The boat ride with Sergio was great. It's wonderful to be able to sail off the coast of Barcelona on a sailboat like yours. As a captain, Sergio has been perfect: attentive, friendly, and caring for everyone. And the best part of all the swim on the high seas: a totally recommended experience!
A perfect afternoon. The sea was great and the captain was very kind and attentive!! To repeat it without hesitation. Thank you very much Sergio

Incredible experience!!! Highly recommend! Sergio was a wonderful host and it was so much fun being out on his beautiful boat with a few others from different places! A great way to relax, meet new people and enjoy Barcelona! Thank you so much Sergio!!!

If you are in Barcelona you definitely should go on this sail boat. The boat is large and swimming in the Mediterranean Sea was amazing. Sergio was great. I would highly recommend. One of the best things we did in Barcelona!!

Sergio is a great human/captain/host. He made us feel comfortable and safe when the water was choppy. Really enjoyed the time spent on the boat and the intimacy of the experience. Really recommend it for anyone wanting to go out on the open sea, was really great to swim in the open ocean! Thanks for the amazing experience Sergio!

Sergio was awesome , weather was alittle rough for our day and he gave us the option to go on our scheduled day or try another time. We decided to go and despite the waters not being optimal for us to swim (too rough) it was an awesome time and really a cool experience . I highly recommend .

A unique experience to see Barcelona from the sea. We really enjoyed the sail. Sergio and Olga were very easy going and made sure everyone was comfortable and enjoying themselves. To end the trip with drinks and snacks was an added highlight. I would thoroughly recommend this trip.

My friend and I had an amazing time at Sergios boat! We got to swim and just enjoy the ocean breeze. I unfortunately got suuuuper seasick - the waves were pretty crazy that day - and was almost sure my trip was ruined. But then Sergio asked me if I wanted to steer the boat on the way back, because it helps if you're seasick to focus on something, and that honestly helped tremendously. My seasickness went away, and I could yet again enjoy the ocean breeze and beautiful view - plus it was so much fun steering the boat. We can both truly recommend this trip.
Great sailing with Sergio! He is an awesome host. We had a very good time. I would totally recommend this to anyone visiting Barcelona.
A wonderful experience, a nice host, who even let my wife steer the boat out of sickness. Swimming in the sea was awesome. Reccomend to all.

Cool adventure to mix up our travels in Barcelona. It was fun to swim in the open ocean and Sergio was very nice with snacks and cava. The photo is a little deceiving because there was no land nearby or crystal clear waters. We sailed straight out and swam in the open ocean which can very rough. That said, still fun.

Sergio warned us the day before that the sea was going to be quite rough and that it would be windy. He suggested us to reschedule the boat trip if we wanted, which was kind! However, we decided not to reschedule and went on the rough sea. It was a very lovely experience that I would recommend to everyone who wants to see Barcelona from a different perspective! Unfortunately we were not able to swim due to the weather. We had some delicious cava and snacks after our boat trip when we were back in the harbour. Thank you Sergio for the lovely experience!

Sergio was very friendly and welcoming. His boat was of great quality and my wife and I truly enjoyed the trip. He handles the boat very well and made sure everyone was comfortable. He had lots of information about Barcelona, from the sights we saw to great restaurants to visit and he was very easy to talk to. Muchas Gracias Sergio!
Sergio offered a great excursion for those visiting the area. He was welcoming and very informative!! I highly recommend booking if you enjoy being out on the sea
Absolutely loved Sergio and the wealth of knowledge he had while we were on the sailboat. He was both accommodating and kind! The swimming was absolutely beautiful!

Wonderful! My family of five all really enjoyed the whole experience! It was everything we hoped for! Nice boat ride, good refreshments, swimming was really fun, and friendly people from all over the world. Sergio was the perfect host and captain! One of the highlights of our trip to Barcelona!

Going on this trip was a great experience! Sergio was super welcoming, and made everyone feel at home on his boat, although we were four different groups from around the world. It was super relaxed and not awkward at all. We got to sunbathe and swim in the open sea, under the scorching sun. Sergio offered great snacks and some cava! Recommended

We had an amazing night sailing the Mediterranean on Sergio's boat! What a perfect way to wrap up me and my friend's big trip around Europe. The boat was even larger than I expected and we got to sit right up front as we set sail. Eventually, we jumped in warm, blue waters and floated with flamingo tubes. We enjoyed beers, sodas, water, tapas and popped some champagne. What a fun night! Sergio was very friendly and an excellent host.

This was an amazing way to end our trip! Sergio was very friendly, served wonderful tapas/drinks and even had champagne. This is great way to see the city and view of the coast. I would love to do this again! Thank you!

What a wonderful way to experience another view of beautiful Barcelona! Sergio hosted myself and 7 others on a lovely sunset sail complete with snacks, drinks, inflatable toys and a very friendly welcome. I would highly recommend this 2 hour escape!

This was such an amazing experience!! I was so happy that my group of friends and I went on this excursion. Amazing boat and Sergio is really sweet. Would recommend to anyone visiting Barcelona and would like a nice boat trip.

Amazing! Sergio is a great host. He kept a promise he made to me months ago and I really appreciate that. He is very genuine. The weather wasnt the best so the waves were choppy for us so we couldn't swim but that is something out of anyone's control. We had a great time regardless and I highly recommend to anyone visiting Barcelona and looking for a nice chill out experience on the water.

My boyfriend and I had an amazing time on our boat ride with Sergio! It was a great way to see Barcelona and to get away from the normal tourist areas. I would definitely recommend to anyone seeking a different view of the city and a nice relaxing time!

Sergio was a great host and guide! He was so friendly, patient, and generous, and did everything to make sure we had the best trip possible. Just know when booking that obviously the weather has a big impact on the trip -we were not able to swim because the water was too choppy.
Sergio is very kind and makes you comfortable during the trip. I loved the trip because of the snacks, drinks and the nice swim!

Fantastic. Great boat. Warm water. Sergio is an awesome host he made everyone feel very welcome. Easy going atmosphere, extremely satisfied. My tip, grab the paddle board for 10 minutes, it makes a great floating sun bed.
Sergio was very friendly and did a wonderful job! We had so much swimming and this experience was a fantastic memory for our trip.

Sergio is a wonderful host. After being in his yacht, a 42 feet Jeanneau, for a few minutes, we felt like we knew him for a long time. Sailing in Barcelona harbor looking at the magnificent skyline of the city dominated by Gaudi's Sagrada Familia was an unforgettable experience. We arrive to his favorite spot where we swam in crystal cleat Mediterranean waters. The yacht has also a very accesible swimming platform and a paddle board and other swimming equipment. I highly recommend this experience; as it will make your stay in BCN really memorable. Thank you Sergio for your kindness, the olives, the Catalan salami and of course the Cava! Alex, Ken and Susan.

This was the highlight of my stay in BARCELONA. I highly recommend this experience. Sergio is a fantastic host. He's fluent in English, Spanish, and Catalan and has that strong catalunyan charm that we've all come to enjoy. 100 points!!!
It was a really great way to spend the day in. Meeting some new people, having fun in the water, enjoying the view and Sergio was really engaging.

The boat tour was wonderful! Although I started to get "sea sick" after about 1.5, I can say it was great!
Sergio and his wife have done everything they can to make my boat tour beautiful and make my sea sickness easier. All in all, I would do it again and again. Everything is perfect. 👍🏽

Sergio and his wife were great. It's a very nice, 14 meter sail boat. He's been sailing for a while, and has good command of the vessel. We went out about 20 minutes, and found a nice spot to swim looking back at the Barca coastline. The water felt great! Crisp, but not too cold in early July. They had a few things for us to float on and relax. After swimming and floating for a while, we came back on board and toured further down the coastline.

There is a cabin in the hull with a bathroom and some area to store small bags in you need. They also had towels and plenty of life vests.

Undoubtedly, there will be people on the boat who don't understand what it's like to be on a boat. The Mediterranean is fairly rough. If you get seasick, take dramamine in advance. Otherwise you ruin it for yourself and make it uncomfortable for the others on board.

Sergio and his wife provided some delicious snacks, beers, and even a bottle of champaign! They were great hosts and the view of the coastline as the sun set was quite memorable!
The trip was beautiful. Sergio and his wife were very attentive and pleasant. We enjoyed the views, a dip in the water, delicious food and quality drinks. Unmissable!

I highly recommend this trip with Sergio. We confused the dates and ended up missing our time slot and he was kind enough to reschedule the next day.

The boat itself was clean and Sergio provided delicious cheese, meat, chips and beverages alcoholic and non-alcoholic. Sergio himself was very friendly and you could tell he truly wanted each person to enjoy the experience.

We went at 6PM and sadly didn't have the sunniest weather but despite that still got to see a stunning sunset and beautiful view of Barcelona. If you are more interested in sun and swim I would recommend an earlier trip but if you're looking for that sunset, 6PM is perfect.

Wow, what an amazing time on Sergio's beautiful boat! As we made our way away from land, Sergio offered everyone drinks but when he went to check on the drinks, he advised us they weren't yet cold enough for enjoyable consumption. This is one element of the experience that could have been handled better as our departure time was set so the food and snacks could have been prepared earlier to ensure they were ready for the guests.

Eventually, Sergio got us to a location where he felt comfortable for us all to enter the water. We swam for what must have been at least a half hour while Sergio navigated the boat amongst the waves. The entire group seemed to have fun in the water and this was my first time swimming in a sea, clear of land. It was a great experience.

Once everyone was back on board, Sergio navigated the boat back to shore and then as a group we enjoyed a few drinks and snacks once docked safely back in the harbour. Sergio was very apologetic that the sea conditions were less than optimal as he said if the weather forecast had advised him of the wind and choppy water conditions he would have cancelled the event. We were appreciative that he offered to bring us on another excursion on another day to make up for the poor conditions, but it didn't fit our schedule.
